jobs.title: Aviation Project Manager
jobs.description:
Ardurra is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our thriving Aviation Group in Boise ID, Coeur d'Alene, ID, Spokane, WA, Wenatchee, WA

At Ardurra, we’re more than an engineering and consulting firm—we’re a team dedicated to shaping the future through smart solutions and strong partnerships. Our mission is simple: empower our people to deliver innovative, sustainable projects that make a real impact on communities. Guided by our core values—Client Driven, Uniquely Nimble, Low Bureaucracy, Team Collaboration, Unlimited Opportunities, Relationship Focused, and Entrepreneurial Spirit—we foster a culture that puts people first.

Primary Function

Ardurra is looking for an Aviation Project Manager for our growing aviation group. In this key role, you will be responsible for overseeing projects and serving as a client manager for airport design and construction projects within specific regions. The ideal individual will provide mentoring to junior staff and QA/QC.

The ideal individual for this role will be joining a very well-established aviation group with a diverse workload in airfield service projects. From project planning, regulatory approvals, environmental compliance, financial planning, legislative strategy, land acquisition, and design phasing, this individual will be heavily involved in projects from design to completion!

Primary Duties

Project management
Marketing
Client development
Staff Supervision and mentoring
Quality control of project design and contract documents
Office Support during construction

Education and Experience Requirements:

Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or a related field
PE License required
8+ years' experience in the airport design and/or construction field, either in private industry or government service
Airport design and project management experience a must
Aviation engineering & construction administration experience required
Strong knowledge of FAA advisory circulars related to airport design and the FAA grant process
Strong computer skills
Excellent communication skills
Ability to lead and mentor existing staff and develop new staff as needed to support growth of the aviation group
Self-motivated, team-oriented individual with the ability to work on challenging projects in a team environment

Why Ardurra?

While Ardurra offers competitive compensation and rich benefits programs, it is our culture that truly sets us apart from our peers. We nurture a family-like culture, striving to create a work environment that is enjoyable, challenging and rewarding but also fun. We are acutely focused on developing our staff, whether through our internal Ardurra Academy or through our industry-leading Leadership program. We have made a deliberate and focused commitment to nurture a people-centric culture where people are: valued as individuals; supported in their professional and career development with multiple, varied career paths; provided the tools and resources to be successful, engaged, and satisfied in their work; and positive benefits, time-off programs, and flexibility to help maintain a healthy balance between work and home.

jobs.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Our team at Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), is united by a commitment to collaboration and scientific excellence, building on a strong foundation of innovation, expertise, and reliability. Guided by our vision to help researchers rapidly move from the lab to life-changing advances, we work closely with global partners to accelerate progress and genomics breakthroughs across fields like cancer, infectious disease, rare genetic disorders, and more. At IDT, you’ll be part of a culture rooted in continuous learning and improvement—where your growth fuels our mission to accelerate the pace of genomics and helps shape a healthier, brighter future for all.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Senior Project Manager
is responsible for the success of large strategic projects. As needed, they may also provide management for a small program and will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering cross-functional IT projects across the organization in alignment with enterprise delivery standards and governance. They plan, execute and implement projects to deliver intended business outcomes, ideally on time, on budget and within scope according to business priorities. Throughout the lifecycle of the projects, the Senior Project Manager ensures consistent, reliable, and transparent project execution which effectively and efficiently utilizes organization resources.

This position reports to the Director IT Project and Portfolio Management and is part of the Information Technology (IT) team. There is a preference for candidates who can work on-site in Coralville, IA, or Fargo, ND.
While this req is posted as on-site in the US, applications from qualified candidates in other US locations
will be considered equally.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Plan and manage IT projects across multiple domains, including application, infrastructure, platform, and digital initiatives.
Develop and maintain project plans, including scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, and resource needs while ensuring projects follow defined delivery methodologies, standards, and governance processes.
Coordinate cross-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure effective execution and issue resolution.
Track and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, escalating as appropriate through governance channels.
Provide clear and timely project status reporting, including milestones, risks, and delivery health

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline. PMP certification strongly preferred.
Prefer minimum of five years project management experience serving in the role as a project manager
Knowledge and experience in the use of project management and SDLC methodologies and tools demonstrated mastery of process change, product development, manufacturing or software development.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in addition to facilitation and presentation skills.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements

Ability to travel – list specifics 5% travel, overnight, within territory or locations
Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record
Ability to lift, move or carry equipment up to 0 lb, any other physical requirements

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

Project management, DBS certification (i.e., visual project management, problem solving, daily management, etc.)

IDT, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.

At IDT we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for IDT can provide.

The salary range for this role is $95K – 130K per year. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future.

This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

jobs.title: Sr Client Project Manager
jobs.description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem
ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.

As a Sr Client Project Manager, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!

Job Summary:
The Sr Client Project Manager is accountable for managing the delivery of projects in compliance with ACI policies and customer contractual commitments. They lead and collaborate with a team to deliver projects of varying levels of complexity (typically between a 6–12-month duration) with minimal supervision. They are responsible for managing multiple projects in parallel, aligned to ACI’s project methodology. They facilitate communication with customers and internal departments to ensure the status of the project are clear, while effectively managing risks, issues and core Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). The Sr Client Project Manager oversees a project from its inception through to its execution and final delivery. They maintain and share schedules while monitoring the project’s budget. Ultimately, they guide projects to successful completion within scope and budget that meets or exceeds quality standard within defined timeframes.
Job Responsibilities:
- • Understands all contractual commitments and ensures these are tracked with the customer.

- • Ensures project scope and baseline to ensure delivery is compliant and organizational standard change control tracking is applied.

- • Monitors the project budget, tracks any changes to the scope or schedule that may impact the budget and provides accurate resource forecasts based on project estimated completion.

- • Develops comprehensive project plans, schedules, agreements and proposals and ensures projects are completed within budget and defined timeframes. Identifies and addresses barriers to goal achievement.

- • Directs all aspects of projects including but not limited to research, analysis, documentation, design/development, testing, negotiation, problem resolution, training, status reporting, implementation, deliverables, project closing and post-rollout review/audit. Ensures all project deliverables are met and delivered to customer in accordance with contractual commitments.

- • Provides accurate project Estimated Time to Completion (ETC) to the revenue accounting team on a monthly basis to ensure precise revenue forecasting

- • Establishes a project governance model to ensure all relevant stakeholders are aware of project statues and assist with resolving escalations.

- • Manages project issues and risks (technical and non-technical) through identification, evaluation, tracking, communication and mediation. Maintains RAID log for projects.

- • Ensures the project team is equipped with the right procedures to deliver the quality solutions needed to meet project commitments.

- • Updates project management data on reporting and management systems, such as Jira and Salesforce.

- • Reviews and approves timecards submitted by project team members.

- • Ensures that weekly project updates are maintained and shared with both the internal and external stakeholders.

- • Manages the relationship with customers and all stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and collaboration.

- • Conducts and manages post-project evaluation to identify successful and unsuccessful project elements.

- • Collaborates with internal stakeholders and the customer to determine the appropriate project methodology. The methodology a customer project manager would typically be required to use include:
o Waterfall (linear-sequential life cycle)
o Agile – SCRUM or Kanban
o A hybrid model combining aspects of the above
o When SCRUM is used, the Client Project Manager would fill the Scrum Master role while also handling other responsibilities beyond the standard Scrum Master definition.

- • Ensures the customer is aligned with the methodology to be used for the project and the budget, scope and planning tracking is aligned prior to the project proceeding via a method adoption workshop.

- • Provides guidance to newer team members.

- • Performs other duties as assigned.

- • Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience required for the job:
- Bachelor’s Degree and/or equivalent work experience.

- 7+ years client project management experience, including 5+ years in the payments/ financial industry .

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed for the job:
- Specific project management training preferred

Competencies
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.

- Advanced organizational and planning skills

- Strong stakeholder management and relationship building

- Advanced problem-solving abilities

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in South Africa on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future.
In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com
ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally.
Important Notice About Recruitment Scams
Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company ( www.aciworldwide.com / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description

Job Summary

The Senior Project Manager leads complex, enterprise-wide initiatives and drives strategic business process improvements that enhance operational efficiency, organizational effectiveness, and financial performance. This role manages cross-functional projects, aligns stakeholders around business priorities, and champions organizational change to support EMS|MC's strategic objectives.

Serving as a senior-level contributor within the Project Management Office (PMO), this role exercises independent judgment in navigating competing priorities, resolving complex challenges, and influencing strategic decisions. The Senior Project Manager also contributes to PMO strategy, governance, and continuous improvement while mentoring less experienced project managers and promoting consistent, effective project delivery across the organization.

Major Responsibilities/Activities

Support the development and execution of the PMO's strategic priorities, roadmap, operational goals, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Lead enterprise-level capacity planning and resource tracking to forecast project needs, identify delivery constraints, and optimize resource allocation.
Co-lead the development, implementation, and refinement of PMO governance frameworks, project management standards, templates, and reporting practices.
Ensure major initiatives align with corporate strategy, compliance requirements, and executive priorities.
Lead large-scale, complex, and cross-functional projects from initiation through completion, exercising independent judgment and accountability for successful delivery.
Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, including scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and deliverables.
Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues, establishing appropriate escalation paths and contingency plans.
Manage changes to project scope, timelines, and budgets by evaluating tradeoffs, assessing operational impacts, and communicating recommendations to stakeholders.
Coordinate project testing and validation activities, including quality assurance, regression testing, and user acceptance testing, to ensure deliverables meet established business requirements and quality standards.
Lead organizational change management efforts by assessing the people, process, and technology impacts of project implementations and developing appropriate communication, training, and stakeholder readiness strategies.
Establish and monitor project success measures, including operational efficiencies, financial impacts, and realized business benefits, to evaluate outcomes and support continuous improvement.
Partner with business leaders to develop and implement adoption strategies, address resistance to change, and monitor adoption metrics to support successful transitions and sustained operational improvements.
Serve as a trusted advisor and primary liaison to executive sponsors, business leaders, external clients, and third-party vendors, facilitating alignment and resolving competing priorities.
Prepare and present executive-level project updates, dashboards, and steering committee presentations highlighting project performance, risks, and strategic outcomes.
Mentor and coach less experienced project managers, providing guidance on project delivery, stakeholder management, organizational change, and professional development.
Delegate and oversee project workstreams as appropriate, balancing team development opportunities with project priorities and delivery risks.
Support the PMO Director in overseeing PMO operations, strategic initiatives, and project delivery priorities, providing coverage as needed.
Maintain current knowledge of project management methodologies, industry best practices, and emerging tools through ongoing professional development.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Required Education, Skills, & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Management, Operations Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Six to eight (6-8) years of progressively responsible project management experience, including leading complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to assess business needs, define project requirements, and recommend process improvements.
Experience managing project scope, schedules, resources, risks, and stakeholder expectations while supporting project governance, resource planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Strong leadership, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and navigate competing priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing project documentation, executive presentations, and status reports.
Proficiency in English is necessary for job-related communication, including understanding policies, writing correspondence, and engaging with colleagues or clients.

Preferred Education, Skills, & Experience

Experience mentoring or coaching project managers or other project team members.
Proficiency with project management tools such as Jira, Monday.com, or similar platforms.
PMP or other comparative Agile project management certification(s).

Working Environment

The office environment is a controlled indoor setting with minimal exposure to adverse conditions.
Noise levels in the office are typically moderate and consistent with a standard office setting.
For employees approved to work in a hybrid or remote setting, a quiet, private workspace free from significant distractions is required to ensure productivity during work hours.
A reliable internet connection is required for hybrid/remote work. EMS|MC will provide necessary equipment, including a computer, monitor, keyboard, mouse and headset.

Physical Requirements

Sitting: frequent and prolonged periods of sitting at a desk while working on a computer.
Communication: frequent and prolonged periods of speaking, listening, reading, and writing.
Fine motor skills: frequent use of hands for typing and operating a computer mouse.
Movement: occasional walking and climbing of stairs; limited bending, kneeling, lifting, and carrying of office-related items.
Travel: must be able to travel occasionally to attend required company meetings.

Pay:
$80,000-$90,000 annually, with final compensation based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and business needs. Individuals in this role are eligible to participate in a discretionary bonus plan and a comprehensive benefit package, including a retirement plan, health coverage, paid time off and other benefits provided in accordance with applicable law. Visit https://emsmc.com/careers/ to explore our total rewards package.

Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities as needed to support their ability to perform these essential functions. If you require an accommodation for this position or to participate in the application process, please contact HR at humanresources@emsmc.com .

The responsibilities and duties outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and may be subject to change to meet the needs of the business. This job description is not an implied contract of employment and does not alter the at-will employment relationship.

There is no anticipated closing date for applications; The role will remain open until filled.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States now and in the future; this role does not offer current or future visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: VBC Program Manager
jobs.description:
Compensation:
$105,000 - $120,000

Reports to:
Director of VBC Operations

Direct Reports:
VBC Operations Coordinators and Patient Engagement Representative

Location:
Remote (with the ability for limited travel to facility partners and team meetings)

About Vitae Health Systems:

Founded in 2018, Vitae Health Systems is one of the largest providers of behavioral health, internal medicine, and podiatry services to residents of Skilled Nursing and Assisted Living Facilities. Headquartered in Chicago, IL, we currently operate in over 10 states and are rapidly expanding throughout the USA.

Overview

Vitae launches its ACO under the CMS Long-term Enhanced ACO Design (LEAD) Model on January 1, 2027, building on our experience in ACO REACH High Needs. The VBC Program Manager builds and runs the operating rhythm of the LEAD ACO, making sure the work that drives results (beneficiary alignment, utilization, quality performance, and program compliance) is tracked, scheduled, and followed through on time.

This is a hands-on operating role. You will lead the VBC operations team, run the weekly and monthly performance cadence with the VBC data resource, and work with the VBC clinical team and operations managers to turn performance data into clear, prioritized actions. You own the calendar, the cadence, and the follow-through. Clinical standards and compliance decisions remain with clinical and compliance leadership.

Key Responsibilities

LEAD ACO Operating Cadence and Performance Tracking

Run the weekly team huddle and monthly performance review covering alignment, utilization, quality, and reported spend, using KPIs and targets set by VBC leadership
Track performance against the LEAD quality measures and Prevention and Quality Plan milestones, and report variances to leadership
Monitor utilization drivers (admissions, readmissions, ED visits, post-acute stays) and confirm high-risk patients have a named owner and documented action, escalating gaps to clinical leadership
Review operational CMS reports and data feeds monthly, flag variances early, and escalate risks with a recommended path
Maintain the master calendar of CMS deadlines and deliverables, with a named owner for each, and follow up so nothing is missed

Alignment and Compliance Oversight

Oversee the voluntary alignment program against leadership-set targets and deadlines, including a documented pre-submission review before each CMS submission
Oversee reconciliation of CMS alignment lists to census and EHR data, and lead root cause reviews on avoidable attrition (deaths, hospice elections, moves, Medicare Advantage enrollment)
Reconcile Participant and Preferred Provider lists to HR and credentialing records at the TIN/NPI level, escalating any change that needs a leadership or Compliance decision
Verify that beneficiary notifications and outreach activities are completed, tracked, and documented to CMS requirements, in partnership with Compliance

Cross-Functional Partnership

Work with operations managers on how VBC activities are scheduled and delivered at the facility and NP level, surfacing barriers early and avoiding unnecessary burden
Partner with VBC clinical leadership so workflows, checklists, and handoffs reflect clinical standards
Support development of provider-facing materials (scorecards, tip sheets, trainings) with the clinical and data owners, coordinating timelines and operational input

Data, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Submit and sequence reporting requests to the VBC data resource through a single intake, review data for reasonableness before use in reviews, and flag manual work that could be automated
Prepare the performance summaries the Director of VBC Operations presents to senior leadership and ACO governance, aggregating data, clinical, and operational input
Lead root cause reviews when measures move off target and turn findings into action plans with named owners and due dates, tracking each to closure and routing clinical actions to clinical leadership
Facilitate a quarterly improvement cycle (plan, do, study, act) based on financial and performance results, with the Director of VBC Operations as sponsor: convene Finance, clinical, and data partners to select opportunities, assign actions, evaluate results, and document learning in a VBC operating playbook

Team Leadership

Lead the VBC operations team and serve as its first point of contact: coach, set priorities and escalation thresholds, build SOPs with process owners, and resolve operational questions and blockers within defined boundaries, escalating strategic, financial, compliance, and policy matters to the Director of VBC Operations
Provide input to the Director of VBC Operations on structure and staffing as scope grows

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: The master CMS calendar is in place with named owners. The weekly and monthly cadence is running and escalation thresholds are defined. The first quarterly improvement cycle is launched, with opportunities, owners, measures, and evaluation dates set. Team members have clear goals and documented workflows
First year: Two or more improvement cycles are completed with documented results and feed a VBC operating playbook. Alignment, quality, and utilization are tracked against targets all year, with action plans when a measure is off target. Escalations arrive with context and a recommended path

Requirements

Required

Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, nursing, or a related field
4+ years in value-based care, ACO operations, or population health (provider-side strongly preferred)
Direct experience in a CMS ACO model (ACO REACH, especially High Needs, MSSP, or LEAD)
Experience in post-acute, SNF, or long-term care
2+ years managing staff
Track record running recurring operating cadences and hitting deadlines
Experience running structured improvement cycles (e.g., PDSA, Lean) and building playbooks
Working knowledge of CMS alignment (claims-based and voluntary), ACO quality measures, beneficiary protections and marketing requirements, and benchmark and settlement basics
Ability to drive follow-through across clinical, operational, and data teams without direct authority
Clear communicator who can explain data to clinicians and leaders, and is comfortable with financial and utilization reports, Excel, BI dashboards, and EHR data

Preferred

Understanding of NP-led care teams
Clinical background (e.g., RN)
Master's degree

Benefits

Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
Short Term & Long Term Disability
Training & Development
Work From Home
Free Food & Snacks
Wellness Resources

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Technical Program Management Team

The Technical Program Management team at Affirm operates at the intersection of strategy, product, and engineering execution. We are versatile operators and trusted strategic partners who drive complex initiatives, design our planning engines, and architect operational frameworks that power the technology behind Affirm's business. Guided by our commitment to putting the customer first and pushing the envelope, we elevate how teams collaborate, resolve critical tradeoffs, and turn high-level vision into scalable reality.

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to oversee high visibility planning programs for our teams and help streamline our processes for building and delivering great customer and merchant products. As our products scale in complexity to meet our accelerating business and expanding product lines, our business and technology process management practices need to scale with it. In this role, you will work closely with engineering, product, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to align efforts with goals, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive change initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Drive complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible transformation & operational programs in service of our team’s mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives
Coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across the company to drive alignment on strategy, priorities, and key decisions.
Implement lean processes and drive towards better ways of working to realize value from planning, ask questions that clarify priorities and push the team to be effective, and build a culture of continuous iteration and improvement
Establish and run data-driven operational frameworks to view portfolio performance against OKRs, accelerate value realization by enabling right investment decisions, influence and train teams on more effective ways of working, and create excitement around change to increase adoption
Develop communication strategies to ensure critical information flows seamlessly across the organization
Partner with cross-functional teams to plan change requirements, identify risks, manage dependencies, and establish tools and forums to drive clarity and efficiency
Identify and distill needs, experiment with new ideas to address systemic inefficiencies and bring transparency, visibility, alignment, and promote accountability across the organization

What We Look For

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
8 years of proven experience managing programs, processes, and change management in a technology-focused environment
Strong technical background with a deep understanding of software development processes
Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams
Obsesses over getting the details right but knows how to make tradeoff decisions
Strong stakeholder management with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams
Track record of successfully implementing frameworks at scale and building relationships in a remote friendly culture
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and consulting skills
Passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better
Prior experience in FinTech, Payments or Commerce is a plus.

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

At Aldevron, one of Danaher's 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives, and we're all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

At Aldevron, we deliver world-class CDMO services that accelerate the development of groundbreaking therapies. Our mission is to be the engine of innovation for genomic medicine pioneers. As a member of our team, you'll help bring life-changing innovations to life - impacting millions around the world. We bring together deep scientific expertise, an unwavering commitment to quality, and a collaborative spirit to drive progress. Whether you're launching your career or bringing years of experience, we value the unique perspective you bring. The Senior Program Manager, Plasmid DNA
is responsible for leading Aldevron's most strategic and complex plasmid DNA programs, with a primary focus on marketed products, commercial supply, and late-phase clinical programs progressing through process validation, Process Performance Qualification (PPQ), regulatory readiness, and commercial launch.

This role serves as the senior client-facing program leader for assigned programs and integrates commercial agreements with technical and operational execution. The Program Manager ensures alignment across scope, schedule, quality, supply continuity, financial performance, regulatory expectations, and customer commitments throughout validation, PPQ, launch preparation, recurring commercial supply, and lifecycle management.

The Program Manager partners closely with Business Development, Legal, Contracts, Project Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Technical Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership to convert contractual commitments into executable plans, resolve complex issues, protect Aldevron's business interests, and build durable strategic client partnerships.

This position reports to the Vice President, North America Sales and is part of the Program Management Organization located in Fargo, ND and will be fully remote.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Lead Program and Project Execution: Lead highly complex, multi-program portfolios across strategic accounts, owning end-to-end delivery across multiple concurrent projects with significant revenue, risk, and cross-functional dependencies, ensuring alignment with timelines, budgets, and KPIs.
Cultivate Strategic Client Relationships: Own and influence senior-level client relationships and account strategy, acting as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, navigating escalations, and shaping program direction and long-term partnership outcomes.
Internal Team Alignment and Development: Drive enterprise-wide alignment and decision-making, leading cross-functional teams through ambiguity, resolving competing priorities, and influencing outcomes across functions and leadership levels.
Ensure Operational Excellence and Governance: Establish and maintain program governance structures, track project metrics, forecast capacity, and provide regular updates to senior leadership on project status, risks, and opportunities. Translate master service agreements, statements of work, supply and quality agreements, amendments, and change orders into executable operating requirements, and partner with Business Development, Legal, Contracts, and Finance to assess feasibility, manage scope change, support negotiations, and protect Aldevron's commercial and contractual position.
Support Business Growth and Continuous Improvement: Responsible for overall program health, capacity strategy, business growth, including forecasting demand, identifying risks, leading proposals and renewals, and influencing account expansion and continuous improvement initiatives.

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

B.S. or B.A. required. Advanced degree in scientific field strongly preferred (e.g. molecular biology, biology, biotechnology, biochemistry)
Prefer 7+ years of experience in a client-facing role as a project, program, or account manager within the life sciences, with preference for 5+ years in a GMP-regulated CDMO environment
Experience managing programs and contracts in a regulated biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or medical device related field required
Working knowledge of plasmid DNA manufacturing and its use in cell and gene therapy, gene editing, mRNA, vaccines, or other genomic medicine applications; strong preference for late phase/commercial drug product experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to forecast risks and implement sustainable solutions.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

An advanced degree in a scientific, engineering, legal, project management, or business discipline, or a program or project management certification such as PMP.
Direct program leadership for commercial or late-phase plasmid DNA programs through process characterization, technology transfer, process validation, PPQ campaigns, regulatory inspections, commercial launch, recurring supply, or post-approval lifecycle management.
Experience managing strategic accounts, cross-site programs, long-term supply agreements, capacity reservation models, demand planning, forecast commitments, pricing protections, change-order mechanisms, termination provisions, executive governance, or commercial supply continuity.

Ability to travel up to 25% of the time, including travel to the Fargo, ND site and client locations, with overnight travel based on business and customer needs.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Risk Operations Enablement team sits within the Risk Operations org and is responsible for building and operating the core business and strategic programs that are critical to Risk Operations. These programs range from operational excellence initiatives to high-priority, cross-functional initiatives that typically require partnering across broader Risk (e.g., Risk Product) and risk-adjacent (e.g., Policy) teams. More specifically, we both lead initiatives to make step changes in the Risk User Experience and devise and execute strategies to ensure that a wide range of missing-critical business processes are effective at achieving our dual goals of preventing bad actors from exploiting our systems and delivering an exceptional user experience for legitimate users.

What you'll do

You'll partner cross-functionally across Risk (e.g., Risk Product) and Risk-adjacent (e.g., Policy) teams to lead ambiguous, high-priority problem spaces that change the trajectory of Risk Operations. You'll also partner across Risk Operations to deliver and measure processes that enable operational excellence at scale within the Risk Operations org.

Responsibilities

Lead complex global programs, from initial scoping to design and execution and work on high-impact strategic initiatives
Collaborate with multiple stakeholders across Risk Operations, Risk Product, Risk Eng, and other stakeholder teams (e.g., Policy, Data Science) to prioritize and maximize the impact of your projects
Design and launch programs that lead to step-change improvements in our operational processes and business outcomes
Serve as the Risk Operations expert and partner closely with our cross-functional stakeholders to scope and execute large projects to create operational efficiencies and ensure operational readiness
Embody our Operating Principles and foster our values and culture

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

6+ years of experience in risk program management, strategy, management consulting, business operations, or operations program management
The ability to dig deep into the data and think from first principles while delivering the best results
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders with varying priorities and drive creative solutions and commitment to a shared goal
Strong program management skills with experience managing end-to-end execution of projects and programs that have transformed your company's operations
Enjoys solving complex and hard problems and can turn incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs into solid action plans and deliver quantifiable business impact
Ability to identify repeated user and specialist-facing issues and build scalable solutions and processes to address them

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years in consulting
Experience with SQL or willingness to learn
MBA or other graduate degree
Prior experience partnering with Product, Eng, and Operations teams preferred

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

This role blends agile, flow-based delivery practices with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, align stakeholders, manage complex risks, and maintain visibility across broader initiatives.
You’ll work closely with Technical Leads, engineers, and senior stakeholders to ensure that software delivery is predictable, well-governed (lightly), and aligned to programme objectives. This role is ideal for someone who can zoom out to see the bigger picture while still helping teams maintain a healthy delivery flow.

Responsibilities

Programme-Level Coordination & Planning

Coordinate delivery across multiple related projects or workstreams to ensure alignment with programme goals.
Maintain a clear, high-level view of progress, risks, dependencies, and resource needs across the programme.
Support roadmap shaping and programme-level planning with Technical Leads and product/strategy stakeholders.
Facilitate alignment discussions across teams to clarify priorities, architectural considerations, and sequencing decisions.

Agile Delivery Management

Lead delivery activities using Kanban and flow-based agile practices across one or more teams.
Maintain visibility of work-in-progress, blockers, throughput, and upcoming priorities.
Support teams in balancing feature delivery, technical debt, architectural improvements, and research/activity spikes.
Encourage continuous flow, reducing bottlenecks and ensuring smooth transitions between stages of delivery.

Lightweight Governance & Reporting

Provide structured but concise reporting suitable for programme sponsors and senior leadership.
Track progress against objectives, milestones, and commitments across multiple workstreams.
Capture key decisions, risks, issues, and actions in a lightweight but traceable way.
Help define and mature TwinStream’s delivery governance model — ensuring it remains agile and value-driven.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

Identify and manage programme-level risks, ensuring they are surfaced early and escalated appropriately.
Coordinate cross-team and cross-vendor dependencies with clarity and urgency.
Use a pragmatic, simple RAID process to maintain visibility and drive mitigation actions.
Support teams in resolving blockers that span across technical or organisational boundaries.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

Act as the central coordination point for engineering, Technical Leads, internal stakeholders, and (when relevant) customers.
Communicate delivery updates with clarity, tailored to the audience — technical or non-technical.
Align expectations around timelines, scope, assumptions, and emerging risks.

Help establish scalable delivery patterns as TwinStream takes on more complex and multi-stream programmes.
Promote transparency, psychological safety, and a culture of proactive delivery.

Key Skills

Experience managing software delivery across multiple teams or workstreams, not just single-project coordination.
Strong understanding of flow-based agile delivery and programme-level planning.
Proven ability to identify cross-cutting risks, large dependencies, and structural blockers.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at all levels of the organisation.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Program Manager, GTM Excellence
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We're looking for a highly strategic Senior Principal Program Manager to join the GTM Excellence team within Reddit's GTM Strategy & Operations organization. In this heavily executive-facing role, you will operate as a Business Transformation Manager leading large-scale strategic initiatives—specifically owning end-to-end processes, transforming our methodologies, and evolving our systems, data, and products.

The ideal candidate brings immense executive presence, strong judgment, and a deep background in digital media forecasting to build the systems and processes that maximize customer-facing time and create a seamless experience for Reddit advertisers.

Location:
Hybrid. New York, NY; Chicago, IL; San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA

Responsibilities:

Support core GTM leadership by managing Reddit's largest OPEX planning cycles, overseeing complex roadmaps, and ensuring decision-ready documents are prepared for monthly engagements with executive leadership, including the CRO and COO.
Own the end-to-end processes. Example: Manage and optimize stages across the buy cycle, including pipeline, forecasting methodologies, campaign planning, credit checks, credit limits, application, and invoicing.
Act as an extension of senior leadership. Engage heavily with the CRO, COO, and cross-functional senior leaders across Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Data Product to gather buy-in, pressure test ideas, and accelerate execution.
Break down ambiguous, high-impact opportunities into clear problem statements, develop hypotheses, drive analysis, and identify the highest-impact opportunities to improve how Reddit operates.
Own work from idea to execution, including rollout planning, stakeholder communication, training, and adoption. Navigate strong change management processes to ensure smooth transitions across a wide variety of sales spaces.
Evaluate how work gets done today, identify friction points and root causes, and design simpler, more standardized processes, policies, and ways of working that improve seller productivity and the advertiser experience.
Define success metrics, track results, gather feedback, and refine processes over time. Establish governance and guardrails where needed to drive consistency without adding unnecessary complexity.

Required Qualifications:

8-12+ years of experience in strategic program management, business transformation, strategy & operations, or a related field.
Background in Digital Media companies (experience at a platform + agency is highly preferred).
Executive communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be comfortable being put in front of and influencing C-suite stakeholders (CRO, COO) and acting as a seamless extension of leadership.
Proven ability to operate in ambiguity and independently structure complex problems into clear recommendations and action plans.
Experience leading change management initiatives across cross-functional teams, from initial problem framing through implementation and adoption.
Ability to balance high-level strategic thinking with hands-on execution; this role requires an owner, not just a coordinator.

Preferred Qualifications:

Startup experience in addition to larger tech/media platforms.
Strong foundational experience in basic strategy & operations or business operations.
Expertise in triaging complex issues, conducting root cause analysis, and utilizing competitive intelligence.
Familiarity with sales tools and technology that improve seller efficiency and productivity, including workflow automation and AI-enabled ways of working.
Deep Forecasting experience, including a proven track record of managing and transforming forecasting processes and the full RFP-to-invoice lifecycle.

Benefits:

Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
401k with Employer Match
Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
Family Planning Support
Gender-Affirming Care
Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager

Mission Critical Data Center Programs (HVAC)

$140,000-$190,000 + Performance Bonus + 401K

Location:
Remote, United States

About Our Client

Zest Technical is partnering exclusively with a North American leader in the sustainable design and advanced manufacturing of custom air handling and liquid cooling systems. With decades of HVAC engineering and manufacturing expertise, they deliver energy-efficient solutions for mission-critical industries including hyperscale and modular data centers, healthcare, life sciences, semiconductors and advanced manufacturing.

The Opportunity

Our client is expanding its Service organisation to support some of the world’s largest hyperscale data center projects. They are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead onsite execution of complex HVAC service and construction programs.
You will be the on-site face of the business for customers, General Contractors (GCs) and mechanical and electrical trade partners. You will own execution across both air-side equipment (CRAC/CRAH units, air handling units, economizers) and chiller/water-side plant (chillers, cooling towers, pumps, piping). Your remit runs from rework and start-up through commissioning, warranty and field support, including BMS and controls integration, in uptime-critical Tier III/IV environments.

Key Responsibilities

Apply project methodologies to drive scalable, repeatable and cost-effective execution across mission-critical HVAC programs
Lead internal and external teams (mechanical contractors, controls integrators, GCs, commissioning agents) across rework, start-up, commissioning, warranty and field support
Lead execution across both air-side and chiller/water-side systems
Coordinate Level 3-5 commissioning, including equipment start-up, functional performance testing and integrated systems testing (IST)
Coordinate OEM technicians and commissioning agents to validate cooling capacity and redundancy design
Track progress, risks and interdependencies across equipment delivery, refrigerant piping, ductwork and controls sequencing against construction schedules
Ensure strict adherence to safety requirements including LOTO, confined space and hot work, particularly in live or near-live data halls
Act as primary escalation point and strategic liaison with GCs, mechanical engineers and data center operators on scope, schedule and change management
Oversee Superintendents and other onsite staff
Represent the business at all GC and project meetings, with regular construction-site presence

About You

7+ years of progressive experience in HVAC service operations or project management, ideally within mission-critical or data center environments
Proven track record managing complex HVAC mechanical programs across both:
Air-side systems: CRAC/CRAH units, air handlers, precision cooling and VRF
Chiller/water-side systems: chillers, cooling towers, condenser water and chilled water piping
Direct experience in data centers, hyperscale, colocation or other uptime-sensitive facilities strongly preferred
Working knowledge of mechanical drawings and sequences of operation
Working knowledge of BMS/controls platforms and protocols such as BACnet, Niagara and Modbus
Experience with ERP/CRM systems, service management platforms and performance dashboards
Mechanical or HVAC engineering background preferred; strong operational, business or technical program management experience within HVAC will also be considered
Strong planning and follow-through, clear communication at all levels, a customer-first mindset, and composure under tight, shifting priorities

What’s on Offer

Salary of $140,000-$190,000 depending on experience, plus performance bonus
Medical, dental and vision insurance
401(k)
Employee assistance program
Paid time off
A fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment supporting the AI infrastructure boom
Genuine career progression, with a culture that promotes from within
An inclusive, diversity-friendly workplace

jobs.description:
What You’ll Do

Eaton announced, on June 11, 2026, the intent to combine its Mobility Group (including both the Vehicle and eMobility segments) with a new company. We expect to complete this process by the end of the first half of 2027. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the transaction closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.

Eaton India Innovation Center is currently seeking a Software Program Manager to join our team in Pune. This individual contributor will work in a matrix environment to lead software development activity supporting DCDC Converters, Transmission Control Units, Power Distribution and Protection Units and other related automotive EV products.

We make the electric revolution work. Every day, we work to improve people’s lives and the environment by making power management technologies that are more reliable, efficient, safe and sustainable.

Preparing for the electrified future of mobility takes the passion of every employee around the world. We create an environment where creativity, invention and discovery become reality, each and every day. It’s where bold, bright professionals like you can reach your full potential—and where you can help us reach ours.

Eaton India Innovation Center is collaborating with companies around the globe to innovate the transportation technologies of the future, creating efficient vehicles that travel faster, farther and safer at a lower overall cost to the consumer and the environment.

This role is part of E2S group - part of CSPP CoE."

The primary role of Software Program Manager includes overseeing embedded software project development from start to finish to deliver software on time, of high quality, in compliance with industry standards such as ISO 26262, and in alignment with the hardware development schedules of the associated products. In a matrixed environment, this role will lead a program team of controls and software developers across the globe through clear and concise communication, goal setting and demonstrating good decision making amongst project ambiguity. Collaborating across time zones and engineering stakeholders to align program schedules and dependencies to create a master software plan. In addition, this role will be responsible for project proposal/timing estimations for new project or RFQ activity.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, An MBA, advanced degree, or relevant project management certification is a plus.
10-12 years of Software industry experience with mix of engineering development and Program execution
Minimum 5-7 years of experience supporting or providing project management within embedded software development-related projects.

Skills

Required

Exposure to embedded software development within the Automotive Industry is preferred.
Familiarity with processes and tools for requirements management, change management, and configuration management.
Familiarity with software test methodologies and tools and the development of test plans for embedded systems.
Basic knowledge of functional safety and development processes compliant with safety standards (for example, ISO 26262 or IEC 61508).
Working knowledge of Microsoft Project and PowerPoint.
Basic knowledge of software quality assurance requirements (for example, Automotive SPICE) and their relationship to Quality Management System requirements (for example, IATF 16949) and external auditing processes.

Desired

Strong ethics and values, with the ability to collaborate and build alignment with others.
Ability to manage assigned projects and activities, prioritize work, and deliver results with guidance as needed.
Ability to provide clear customer communication through verbal and written forms, including presentations, with guidance for complex or sensitive topics.
Strong attention to details and multi-tasking skills
Good verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to prepare status reports and technical presentations for internal leadership and customers with review and guidance as needed.
Good interpersonal skills, with the ability to present information and work effectively in group settings.
Ability to coordinate cross-functional activities in a matrix environment.
Good interpersonal, written and oral communication skills."

jobs.title: R-10066680 Senior Hardware Program Manager
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The position has end to end Systems program management responsibility for 13.56Mhz based Wireless charging solutions. This covers responsibility from definition of customer requirements, execution and design-in of final system on customers products.

Job Description

Responsible to interact with lead customers and funnel customer requirements to large multi-disciplinary engineering teams.
Work closely with the lead customer to architect and manage device requirements and certification for system solutions with NFC, wireless power transfer and security.
Engage the global R&D team to achieve on time delivery with world class levels of quality.
Responsible for partnering with the customer’s and internal organization’s R&D, Product Management, and Product Engineer/Test/Manufacturing teams to define schedules and resourcing for key deliverables.
Anticipate and overcome issues to positively impact key financial metrics including gross margin and EBITDA.
Drive delivery of new products from concept and definition phases, through execution of hardware and software solutions to final production ramp at customer
Candidates for this role should possess extensive experience and understanding of the semiconductor industry and the key competitive differentiators for our products including manufacturability, price, power, die size and system performance.
Track customer issues on a weekly basis to successful closure with relevant cross functional engineering teams.
Provide technical support to customers during all phases of product life cycle
Act as the key interface to the customer. Able to engage with customer’s engineers and management
Ensure requirements, change requests and problem reports are analyzed, feedback provided, features planned for and delivered as promised.
Drive program execution across the organization. Set priorities as required.
Create and share objective data-based reports for customer and internal stakeholders.

Qualifications And Experience

Education: A bachelor’s degree is expected. A master’s is preferred. Typical candidates would have specialized in Electrical / Electronics / Computer Engineering Experience: A successful candidate will have 10 years of experience in the semiconductor industry with a track record of successful wireless charging solution launches. This person will have spent good portion of this time as Program Manager for complex projects, interacting with customers and product management. This person will have subject matter expertise in the application, technology, development life-cycle and overall product planning of embedded wireless RF systems.

Requirements

Good understanding of 13.56MHz NFC systems, wireless power transfer technology standards such as ISO14443, NFC Forum WLC specification, Qi, etc.
Strong analytical skills
Business fluency in English
Project management / business development / direct customer management
Experienced Manager with proactive and solution oriented approach
Excellent communication and leadership skills
Strong social competence and ability to work across and integrate multi-cultural / multi-geographical teams

Core Competencies

Program Manage Complex, Fast-Paced Development Projects This person will be a technically gifted program manager. The right person will know how to listen to customer’s needs throughout the process in order to deliver the highest quality product. We seek someone who has the ability to lead with a sense of urgency.
Effective Leadership in a Matrixed Organization This role utilizes engineering talent in a matrixed organization. The right person knows how to effectively manage this type of group in order to deliver a quality product. Additionally, this person can collaborate with diverse groups in the company to leverage NXP’s status as a leader in NFC based wireless charging solutions.
Results-Driven Team Player We are looking for someone with a passion and commitment to make NXP the trusted resource to our customers. The right candidate doesn’t shirk from risks or challenges, is tenacious and can capably navigate through any organizational, operational and strategic.

The base salary range for this position is as mentioned below per year. We also provide competitive benefits, incentive compensation, and/or equity for certain roles.
Company benefits include health. dental, and vision insurance. 401(k), and paid leave. Please note that the base salary range (OR hourly rate) is a guideline, and individual total compensation may vary based on a number of factors such as qualifications, skill level, work location, and other business and organizational needs. This base pay range is specific to California and is not applicable to other locations. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range as of the date of this posting is:
$186,200 to $256,100 annually

jobs.title: TMT Program Manager
jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe building engineering is more than systems and structures, it’s about powering progress and enabling innovation. As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high-performance data centers driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. We bring together mechanical, electrical, structural, and civil engineering experts to solve complex design challenges with precision, creativity, and collaboration. Whether you're optimizing energy efficiency, integrating resilient systems, or engineering the backbone of next-generation facilities, your contributions will help define the future of the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead innovation, engineer impact, and build a legacy of excellence.

HDR is looking for a TMT Program Manager
whose experience focuses on client development and delivery of data center projects. The ideal candidate should have a proven background in successfully delivering various data center and mission critical projects ranging from upfront planning and pre-design activities through detail design, construction support and commissioning. This position is an opportunity to join one of the largest, fastest growing, and comprehensive TMT (Tech, Media and Telecom) practices in the industry. In additional to managing and delivery projects (which is the primary focus of this role), the successful candidate must possess the drive, experience and charisma needed to develop and secure work from a robust global client base and expand upon HDR’s reputation within these markets. This individual will manage multi-disciplinary design teams from project conception to completion. Keen focus on organizational skills and follow-through are required to be successful in this role. This person will work closely with the Regional Building Engineering Services (BES) Business Group Managers as well as our global TMT client management team. Some travel to client sites or other HDR offices is required

Primary Responsibilities:

In the role of TMT Program Manager
, we'll count on you to:

Assume leadership responsibilities for managing multidisciplinary tech media & telecom (TMT) programs with a high degree of technical complexity and non-technical intricacies.
Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of tech media & telecom (TMT) programs, which are all critical to program success.
Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address each client’s specific needs.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of program execution.
This may involve overseeing a broad range of disciplines including, but not limited to: capital planning, change management, commissioning/asset onboarding, communications, document management, environmental planning/compliance, engineering, equity, financial support, organizational strengthening, permitting, planning/design management, program governance, procurement, project management, quality management, real estate, regulatory support, risk management, scheduling, strategic planning, sustainability, and resiliency.
Anticipate and identify potential issues and risks that may impact program implementation, and assist the client with problem-solving, issues resolution, risk mitigation, and timely decision-making.
Provide strategic advice and thought leadership and deploy the required resources to address various program challenges and unanticipated events.
Develop and implement various plans (program management plans, startup plans, and work plans), business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.
Direct the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR and subconsultants staff.
Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communication.
Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance.
Monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.
Monitor the program’s financial performance against pre-established financial metrics and make adjustments as necessary to meet earnings and profitability targets and control losses.
Contribute to the growth of HDR’s program management services by (1) building a long-term trusted advisory relationship with clients; (2) looking for opportunities to expand our services to address the needs of existing clients; (3) supporting the pursuit of new program contract opportunities; and (4) mentoring and training staff working on programs.
Align and communicate with operations and market sector planning for resources, goals, and area growth in the region as they relate to the program needs you are supporting with periodic check-in meetings.
Align, communicate, and mentor project managers within the program you are supporting with periodic check-in meetings.
Perform other duties as needed

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Professional Engineering License
PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
PMI Program Management Professions (PgMP) certification
CMAA Certified Construction Manager (CCM) Certification
AICP Certification
Experience participating in the consultant or owner program management team of at least one (transportation/water/resources) infrastructure program(s) with a capital value of $350 million
Knowledgeable of other alternative delivery/contract models, such as public-private partnership (P3), design-build-finance-operate-maintain (DBFOM), and engineering procurement construction (EPC)
Experience working in an integrated fashion within a Program Management Office (PMO) comprised of consultant and client staff
Willingness to travel and, if needed, commute to a client’s site temporarily
US Citizen

. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in program or project management.
Experience in data centers.
Experience in cyber security, artificial intelligence, analysis, and process engineering.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience in Task Flow.
Experience with Lean, Six Sigma or similar methods to streamline workflows, cut cycle times and improve how well vulnerability remediation programs scale.
Familiarity with data center critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical and cooling controls, and how cybersecurity risk turns into operational and uptime risk.

About The Job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Program Manager for Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity, you will support vulnerability management programs across the operational technology that supports critical infrastructure. These environments have tight downtime limits, safety concerns and complex vendor dependencies, so standard IT remediation practices often don't apply. You will manage vulnerability projects including end-to-end remediation, metrics development, and exceptions reporting. You will also drive the initial triage of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), judging exploitability in an OT context, checking applicability against the asset inventory, and coordinate with the OT Security Review Working Group to deliberate on a severity as needed. You will also build the program structure that makes this repeatable at scale, including tracking in Task Flow, SOPs and swimlanes. The role calls for strong ICS technical knowledge, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn technical risk into prioritized plans that protect both security and uptime.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Read and interpret CVEs and ICS advisories from sources such as CISA ICS-CERT, vendor PSIRTs and Mandiant threat intelligence. Turn the technical findings into clear, actionable guidance for operational teams.
Judge real-world exploitability in an OT context by looking at network exposure, the access an attacker would need, and device mode or state. Check advisories against the OT asset inventory to find affected devices, models and firmware versions, so remediation targets the right assets.
Plan, track and report on cross-functional remediation programs in a project management tool such as Task Flow.
Keep milestones, dependencies, blockers and SLO performance visible. Write and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Run triage decisions on critical vulnerabilities and send qualified findings to the right engineering, operations or vendor teams.
