jobs.title: Lead Program Manager
jobs.description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Role description:

Arcadis is seeking an experienced Lead Program Manager to join our Chicago team. This individual will lead the planning and delivery of complex capital programs for public- and private-sector clients. Programs may include multiple concurrent projects across buildings, transportation, municipal infrastructure, and other capital asset types.

The Lead Program Manager will serve as a trusted client advisor and provide leadership across program planning, governance, project controls, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout. The successful candidate will be a proven program management professional who can organize complex work, lead multidisciplinary teams, develop staff, and build lasting client relationships.

This position will play an important role in establishing and growing Arcadis’ Chicago program management team. Building program experience is preferred, but the primary requirement is demonstrated success leading capital programs and delivering consistent results for clients.

Position Responsibilities

Serve as program lead and primary day-to-day advisor for assigned clients.
Lead multi-project capital programs from planning through design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout.
Establish program governance, delivery procedures, roles, decision-making processes, and reporting requirements.
Develop and oversee program budgets, integrated master schedules, forecasts, risks, changes, and performance reporting.
Lead program planning, project prioritization, delivery-method selection, procurement strategy, and resource planning.
Coordinate project managers, designers, contractors, construction managers, consultants, vendors, and client stakeholders.
Identify program-wide risks, dependencies, and emerging issues and lead the development of practical solutions.
Provide executive-level reporting and recommendations related to cost, schedule, risk, quality, safety, and overall performance.
Establish and maintain effective project controls, document management, change management, quality, and reporting processes.
Maintain accountability for client satisfaction, team performance, and successful program delivery.
Lead, mentor, and develop project managers, assistant project managers, project controls professionals, and other team members.
Support staffing decisions and bring the right technical and program management resources to each assignment.
Lead or support proposals, interviews, contract negotiations, and strategic pursuits.
Build trusted client relationships and identify opportunities to expand Arcadis’ program and project management services.
Collaborate across Arcadis’ buildings, transportation, water, and infrastructure teams to provide integrated client solutions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, architecture, construction management, business, or a related field.
Minimum of 12 years of progressively responsible program management, project management, design management, construction management, or owner’s representative experience.
Demonstrated experience leading complex capital programs or portfolios consisting of multiple concurrent projects.
Experience serving as a primary client contact and trusted advisor to senior client leadership.
Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing project or program managers.
Strong knowledge of program governance, procurement, contracts, project controls, risk management, change management, and executive reporting.
Experience managing program budgets, integrated schedules, forecasts, and performance metrics.
Strong leadership, communication, presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Experience with program management information systems and web-based project management platforms.
Ability to travel to client and project locations as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Licensed Professional Engineer, preferably in Illinois, or the ability to obtain Illinois licensure through comity.
Experience leading building capital programs involving new construction, renovation, modernization, or occupied facilities.
Experience leading transportation, municipal, institutional, or other public-sector capital programs.
Experience establishing or improving a program management office, including governance, standards, controls, and reporting.
Experience with design-bid-build, design-build, construction manager at risk, progressive design-build, or other alternative delivery methods.
Experience with Oracle Primavera P6, Oracle Primavera Unifier, e-Builder, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Kahua, Power BI, or similar systems.
Project Management Professional, Certified Construction Manager, or Registered Architect credential.
Chicago-area client relationships and knowledge of the local consulting and construction market.
Demonstrated success supporting client development, proposals, interviews, and account growth.

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

These benefits include medical, dental, and vision, EAP, 401K, STD, LTD, AD&D, life insurance, paid parental leave, reward & recognition program and optional benefits including wellbeing benefits, adoption assistance and tuition reimbursement. We offer nine paid holidays and 15 days PTO that accrue per year. The salary range for this position is $136,000 - $185,000. jobs.description:
Job Description

Leverage your deep technical expertise and leadership to guide cutting-edge projects, fostering growth and innovation in a dynamic environment.

As a Lead Technical Program Manager at JPMorganChase within Enterprise Technology Infrastructure Platforms Foundational Services team, you will own end-to-end delivery of large-scale infrastructure and platform programs that span engineering, operations, security, architecture, and product. You will be the connective tissue between strategy and execution—translating priorities into integrated plans, driving alignment across many teams, and ensuring delivery moves with startup discipline inside an enterprise environment. Your work directly enables the firm's technology resilience, platform modernization, and engineering velocity at scale.

Job responsibilities

Lead end-to-end delivery of large, cross-functional technical programs across engineering, operations, security, architecture, and product teams, ensuring alignment from strategic intent through executable team backlogs
Build and maintain integrated program plans—including workstreams, milestones, critical path analysis, and RAID logs—while driving consistent execution cadence across all delivery teams
Establish and run program governance structures, including steering committees and working groups, to drive timely decisions, resolve blockers, and maintain delivery momentum
Manage complex cross-team and vendor dependencies, proactively identifying risks and coordinating mitigation strategies to protect program commitments
Partner with engineers and architects to evaluate technical trade-offs, reason about failure modes, and challenge assumptions with data to support sound delivery decisions
Promotes reuse-first, AI-assisted practices for program governance and reporting, ensuring human review and alignment to delivery standards.
Operate with a strong risk and controls mindset, applying change management discipline, incorporating incident learnings, and delivering effectively within regulated and high-control environments
Communicate with clarity and precision—producing concise, executive-ready program updates and facilitating alignment across competing priorities and stakeholder groups
Shape demand and planning processes that connect annual outcomes to team-level backlogs, ensuring work is well-defined, prioritized, and ready for delivery teams to execute
Drive continuous improvement in delivery operating models, incorporating Agile-at-scale practices alongside infrastructure delivery patterns such as release trains, migrations, and change windows
Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate program planning and risk synthesis (e.g., consolidating inputs into integrated plans, RAID, and executive-ready updates), validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity requirements.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Formal training or certification on technical program management concepts and 5+ years applied experience
Experience in program or project delivery, and leading large, cross-functional technical programs end-to-end
Demonstrated experience delivering infrastructure or platform programs in one or more domains: cloud foundations, Kubernetes and container platforms, network, compute or storage, CI/CD and developer platforms, identity and access management, or observability and site reliability engineering
Deep technical fluency in distributed systems concepts, including availability, resiliency, scaling, latency, and inter-service dependencies, with the ability to read architecture diagrams and reason about failure modes
Proven ability to build and manage integrated program plans, governance structures, and delivery operating models that span multiple teams and workstreams
Strong stakeholder management skills, including executive communication, structured facilitation, and the ability to align teams around shared priorities and decisions
Experience delivering in regulated or high-control environments, with working knowledge of change management, risk frameworks, and controls-conscious delivery practices
Proficiency with Agile delivery tools and practices, including backlog management, sprint cadences, and cross-team coordination at scale
Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support program management workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
Ability to review and validate AI-assisted plans, risks, and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and following data handling expectations.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Familiarity with site reliability engineering practices, including service level objectives and indicators, error budgets, incident and problem management, and capacity planning
Experience with cloud migration or platform modernization programs, including infrastructure-as-code and automated provisioning concepts
Knowledge of security-by-design principles, identity and access patterns, vulnerability remediation workflows, and disaster recovery or failover testing
Metrics-driven delivery experience, using indicators such as availability, mean time to recovery, change failure rate, deployment frequency, and platform adoption to inform program decisions
Hands-on experience configuring and optimizing Jira and Confluence environments, including workflows, automations, reporting dashboards, and cross-team ways-of-working standards
Exposure to AI-enabled program automation techniques—such as automated standup summaries, release note generation, or incident theme analysis—with measurable impact on delivery quality or efficiency

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:
Austin,TX; Washington, D.C.

About The Department

Security at Cloudflare is a diverse, focused team committed to helping secure both Cloudflare and our customers. The Security Technical Program Management team sits at the intersection of engineering, security, and business. We define, align, and drive the strategic security programs that reduce risk and advance innovation across Cloudflare, while partnering to build the best solutions for our customers.

About The Role

Cloudflare is seeking a highly skilled, self-motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the company’s strategic Governance, Risk, and Compliance program, initially focused on the Department of Defense Impact Level 4 (IL4) initiative.

As a Technical Program Manager focused on Governance, Risk, and Compliance, you will define, align, and drive complex security and compliance programs that reduce risk and enable Cloudflare’s regulated business. You will manage stakeholder expectations, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and ensure the delivery of predictable, high-impact outcomes.

The ideal candidate is process-oriented yet remains flexible and iterative. You excel at navigating ambiguous technical challenges, fostering collaboration across teams, and asking the insightful questions necessary to drive stakeholders toward measurable results. This position requires a professional capable of managing complex tradeoffs and coordinating teams across global time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance team as its dedicated Technical Program Manager
Lead the integrated IL4 roadmap, milestones, dependencies, and execution cadence
Connect with stakeholders through expert communication and diplomacy to maintain alignment and encourage collaboration
Establish and maintain a program operating cadence: roadmap, governance forums, decision log, risk/issue register, communications plan, and executive reporting
Build automations and AI agents to handle routine program administration at scale
Utilize AI platforms to consolidate diverse project streams into unified roadmaps, generating initial metrics, status updates, and executive reporting dashboards
Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities by identifying tradeoffs early, applying risk-based judgment, and balancing long-term compliance objectives with urgent security needs

Desirable Skills And Knowledge

8+ years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of continuous improvement
Experience in cybersecurity or security program management in a technical, fast-moving environment
BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security or related field or equivalent experience
Proven track record of creating realistic project plans, managing dependencies, and overseeing execution to meet commitments with predictability
Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and authorization frameworks (for example, NIST SP 800-53, RMF, FedRAMP, and DoD SRGs), with the ability to translate requirements into program plans and measurable delivery
Proven ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including executives
Hands-on experience or a strong competency in leveraging AI productivity tools and development platforms to automate routine program administration, with rigorous human-in-the-loop review of AI output
Comfortable managing tight deadlines, changing priorities, and ambiguity
Proven ability to forge and sustain effective partnerships internally and externally
Strong competency with Confluence and Jira and various development methodologies
Embraces technology including automation and AI augmentation
Experience working with multiple time zones and cross-functional teams

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $158,000 - $218,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

Medical/Rx Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
Commuter Spending Accounts
Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
Life & Accident Insurance
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Technical Solutions
jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated and experienced Technical Program Manager to join Datadog’s Technical Solutions organization. This organization is made up of 1,200+ customer-facing technical experts around the world — including Sales Engineers, Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, and Solution Architects — who work with prospects and customers throughout their journey with Datadog to deliver outstanding experiences and drive growth through product adoption.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will lead and support a variety of technical programs that help these customer-facing teams work more effectively. Depending on the needs of the organization, this could include programs related to internal tooling, process improvement, knowledge and content systems, or other cross-functional initiatives. You’ll partner closely with team leads, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders to bring structure and clarity to moderately complex, cross-team programs, and you’ll act as a multiplier for the teams you support by driving programs from planning through delivery. Candidates who have previously led projects for customer-facing technical teams are especially encouraged to apply.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do

Drive delivery of cross-team programs that support one or more Technical Solutions teams — coordinating stakeholders, dependencies, and timelines to keep work on track from kickoff through delivery.
Partner with team leads, subject matter experts, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate program goals into clear, actionable plans, and document scope, timeline, and quality expectations along the way.
Establish and maintain program management fundamentals — project trackers, status updates, risk logs — so stakeholders always have visibility into progress and blockers.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

Job Overview

Senior Project Manager, Data Platform

About the role

We’re looking for a strong, assertive Project Manager to support a consumer data platform program built on a modern cloud lakehouse and AWS. This role will drive delivery of the consumer data foundation, including a canonical data model, consumer data warehouse, governed metrics, and shared data assets used by analytics, data science, risk, and finance teams.

You will own day-to-day execution across multiple workstreams, keep teams moving at pace, and ensure priorities are clear, dependencies are managed, and decisions are made quickly. You will work directly with product management, data engineering, data architecture, analytics, and business stakeholders to remove blockers and maintain momentum.

This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who is comfortable operating with urgency, challenging assumptions, and pushing teams toward timely decisions and accountable execution. You should be able to speak credibly with technical teams on data platform concepts and AWS, while also holding business stakeholders accountable for clarity, prioritization, and responsiveness.

What you’ll do in your first 12 months

Drive execution of the consumer data platform roadmap with a strong bias for speed, clarity, and outcome-based delivery.
Keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel by actively managing milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and releases.
Coordinate across product, engineering, architecture, analytics, risk, and finance teams to ensure delivery stays on track.
Track delivery of critical platform initiatives such as canonical data modeling, data warehouse buildout, metric standardization, and data quality improvements.
Push for rapid resolution of blockers, open questions, and cross-team dependencies before they impact timelines.
Maintain tight control over project plans, RAID logs, status updates, and stakeholder communications.
Challenge engineering estimates and delivery schedules where assumptions are weak, scope is unclear, or dependencies are not fully accounted for.
Push back on business stakeholders when requirements are incomplete, ambiguous, or not actionable, and insist on the clarity needed to move execution forward.
Ensure decisions are documented, actions are assigned, and follow-through happens quickly.
Work with technical teams to understand AWS-based data platform components such as storage, compute, orchestration, pipelines, and access patterns.
Help ensure solutions are tested, documented, and ready for adoption by downstream teams.
Escalate risks early and decisively when timelines, quality, or scope are at risk.

Required qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
10-12 years of project management or program coordination experience, preferably in data, technology, or platform delivery environments.
Experience working on data platforms, data warehouses, lakehouse environments, or enterprise data programs.
Strong working knowledge of data platform concepts such as source-to-target mapping, data pipelines, data quality, metadata, data modeling, and reporting dependencies.
Proven ability to coordinate technical teams and translate between business and engineering stakeholders without losing urgency or accountability.
Familiarity with AWS services used in data platform environments, such as S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, EMR, Lambda, Step Functions, or related services.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to deliver concise, high-signal updates and executive summaries.
Demonstrated ability to challenge estimates and schedules in a structured, logical, and evidence-based way.
Demonstrated ability to push stakeholders to provide clear, complete, and actionable requirements before work begins.
Comfortable operating with ambiguity while creating speed, structure, and accountability.

Preferred qualifications

Experience working in consumer finance, payments, fintech, or risk/data environments.
Experience supporting delivery of canonical data models, shared metrics, or governed data products.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery practices, Jira, Confluence, or similar project tracking tools.
Understanding of cloud data architectures on AWS, including ingestion, transformation, orchestration, access control, and monitoring.
Ability to read or interpret SQL queries and engage effectively with analysts or data engineers on data validation issues.
Experience driving delivery across distributed teams in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.
Strong bias toward action, decisive escalation, and relentless follow-through.

Compensation

Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe building engineering is more than systems and structures, it’s about powering progress and enabling innovation. As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high-performance data centers driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. We bring together mechanical, electrical, structural, and civil engineering experts to solve complex design challenges with precision, creativity, and collaboration. Whether you're optimizing energy efficiency, integrating resilient systems, or engineering the backbone of next-generation facilities, your contributions will help define the future of the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead innovation, engineer impact, and build a legacy of excellence.

HDR is looking for a TMT Program Manager
whose experience focuses on client development and delivery of data center projects. The ideal candidate should have a proven background in successfully delivering various data center and mission critical projects ranging from upfront planning and pre-design activities through detail design, construction support and commissioning. This position is an opportunity to join one of the largest, fastest growing, and comprehensive TMT (Tech, Media and Telecom) practices in the industry. In additional to managing and delivery projects (which is the primary focus of this role), the successful candidate must possess the drive, experience and charisma needed to develop and secure work from a robust global client base and expand upon HDR’s reputation within these markets. This individual will manage multi-disciplinary design teams from project conception to completion. Keen focus on organizational skills and follow-through are required to be successful in this role. This person will work closely with the Regional Building Engineering Services (BES) Business Group Managers as well as our global TMT client management team. Some travel to client sites or other HDR offices is required

Primary Responsibilities:

In the role of TMT Program Manager
, we'll count on you to:

Assume leadership responsibilities for managing multidisciplinary tech media & telecom (TMT) programs with a high degree of technical complexity and non-technical intricacies.
Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of tech media & telecom (TMT) programs, which are all critical to program success.
Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address each client’s specific needs.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of program execution.
This may involve overseeing a broad range of disciplines including, but not limited to: capital planning, change management, commissioning/asset onboarding, communications, document management, environmental planning/compliance, engineering, equity, financial support, organizational strengthening, permitting, planning/design management, program governance, procurement, project management, quality management, real estate, regulatory support, risk management, scheduling, strategic planning, sustainability, and resiliency.
Anticipate and identify potential issues and risks that may impact program implementation, and assist the client with problem-solving, issues resolution, risk mitigation, and timely decision-making.
Provide strategic advice and thought leadership and deploy the required resources to address various program challenges and unanticipated events.
Develop and implement various plans (program management plans, startup plans, and work plans), business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.
Direct the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR and subconsultants staff.
Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communication.
Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance.
Monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.
Monitor the program’s financial performance against pre-established financial metrics and make adjustments as necessary to meet earnings and profitability targets and control losses.
Contribute to the growth of HDR’s program management services by (1) building a long-term trusted advisory relationship with clients; (2) looking for opportunities to expand our services to address the needs of existing clients; (3) supporting the pursuit of new program contract opportunities; and (4) mentoring and training staff working on programs.
Align and communicate with operations and market sector planning for resources, goals, and area growth in the region as they relate to the program needs you are supporting with periodic check-in meetings.
Align, communicate, and mentor project managers within the program you are supporting with periodic check-in meetings.
Perform other duties as needed

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Professional Engineering License
PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
PMI Program Management Professions (PgMP) certification
CMAA Certified Construction Manager (CCM) Certification
AICP Certification
Experience participating in the consultant or owner program management team of at least one (transportation/water/resources) infrastructure program(s) with a capital value of $350 million
Knowledgeable of other alternative delivery/contract models, such as public-private partnership (P3), design-build-finance-operate-maintain (DBFOM), and engineering procurement construction (EPC)
Experience working in an integrated fashion within a Program Management Office (PMO) comprised of consultant and client staff
Willingness to travel and, if needed, commute to a client’s site temporarily
US Citizen

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Planning, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Program management experience consistent with one of the following requirements:
A minimum of three (3) years of program management experience in a deputy role to the Program Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, with a cumulative capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of five (5) years of program management experience as a Project Manager or Project Controls Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, each with a capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of ten (10) years of project management experience as a Project Manager directing a multi-disciplinary team for the delivery of at least two (2) projects, each with a capital value of $50 million or more
Strong leadership skills with experience building a cohesive team culture and managing team members in various locations.
Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to client executives and in front of a large audience in a public setting
Management experience with the implementation of projects or programs using alternative and collaborative delivery methods, including design-build (DB), progressive design-build (PDB), and/or construction management at-risk (CMAR)
Familiar with the various tools used to manage large programs - PMIS, CMIS, scheduling, cost control, document management, risk management, asset management, dashboard analytics, etc.
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

About The Job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Program Manager for Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity, you will support vulnerability management programs across the operational technology that supports critical infrastructure. You will manage vulnerability projects including end-to-end remediation, metrics development, and exceptions reporting. The role calls for strong ICS technical knowledge, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn technical risk into prioritized plans that protect both security and uptime.

jobs.title: IT Program Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an IT Program Manager based in the United States.

The IT Program Manager will provide executive-level leadership for a major federal IT services program supporting the modernization of supply chain and logistics operations within the Department of Veterans Affairs. As the primary point of accountability for contract performance, you will oversee delivery, financial management, customer relationships, and strategic growth. You will lead a large Agile and DevSecOps organization, coordinate multi-vendor partnerships, and ensure services meet contractual and operational expectations. Beyond day-to-day program execution, you will shape long-term account strategy, identify new business opportunities, and strengthen relationships across federal healthcare stakeholders. You will also mentor emerging program leaders and contribute to enterprise delivery practices, innovation, and thought leadership. This is a senior, mission-driven leadership opportunity for an experienced federal IT professional who can combine operational excellence, commercial accountability, and customer-focused strategy.

Accountabilities

Program and Contract Leadership
Own end-to-end program performance, including profit and loss, revenue forecasting, cost and margin management, invoicing accuracy, and monthly financial reporting.
Serve as the primary executive contact for VA leadership, building trusted relationships and positioning the organization as a strategic modernization partner.
Lead, mentor, and develop program staff through performance management, career development, retention, and succession planning.
Manage subcontractors and teaming partners, including workshare arrangements, performance, small business participation goals, and executive escalations.
Participate in program and corporate leadership reviews, risk assessments, and governance forums.
Proactively manage customer satisfaction, resolve issues, and maintain strong contract performance evaluations through documented results and consistent engagement.

Business Growth and Account Development
Identify and develop opportunities for account expansion, including new task orders and follow-on work.
Partner with business development and capture teams on federal healthcare opportunities, contributing technical expertise, proposals, presentations, customer discovery, and solution development.
Build and maintain a 12–24-month account growth strategy and opportunity pipeline, reviewing progress regularly with leadership.
Develop relationships across VA technology, Veterans Health Administration supply chain, and enterprise program stakeholders.
Capture customer insights, lessons learned, and successful approaches to strengthen future proposals and corporate past-performance materials.

People Leadership and Talent Development
Work with Talent Acquisition and Human Resources to recruit, assess, and onboard personnel for core teams and additional Agile delivery teams.
Ensure candidates meet contractual skill, certification, and experience requirements before assignment.
Develop a network of qualified federal supply chain and OEM specialists to support rapid team expansion.
Promote employee engagement and organizational values through regular one-on-ones, team discussions, and retrospectives.
Ensure employees complete required corporate and VA training and maintain current background investigations, access credentials, and Rules of Behavior compliance.

Corporate Contribution and Innovation
Serve as a coach and practitioner for Agile, SAFe, and DevSecOps delivery approaches.
Support the adoption and improvement of AI-assisted software development lifecycle tools by validating use cases, providing feedback, and sharing success stories.
Contribute to federal supply chain thought leadership through approved industry events, conference presentations, and written publications.
Support enterprise initiatives involving process improvement, quality management, audits, and CMMI or ISO assessments.
Share delivery practices and lessons learned to strengthen program execution across the organization.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline; a master's degree is preferred.
12+ years of IT program or project management experience, including at least 5 years managing large federal IT services contracts valued at $10 million or more annually as a Program Manager.
5+ years leading Agile or SAFe DevSecOps organizations of 100+ full-time equivalent employees across multiple concurrent products.
Demonstrated experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Information and Technology programs, with familiarity with frameworks and processes such as VIP, PLM Playbook, VA PARS, TRM, and ATO/A&A.
Experience managing multi-vendor partnerships, subcontractor performance, and complex federal contract requirements.
Background delivering task orders with CLIN-based deliverables and QASP-driven performance management.
Strong technical and program management capabilities, including:
Jira, GitHub, ServiceNow, SharePoint, and Microsoft Project.
SAFe PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, and Agile Release Train coordination.
Integrated Master Schedule development and dependency management.
Risk and issue management, including Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).

Required certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) and SAFe Agilist (SA), SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), or an equivalent SAFe certification.
Preferred certifications: Program Management Professional (PgMP), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), ITIL 4 Foundation, CISSP, or Security+.
Preferred experience: Supporting Veterans Health Administration supply chain or logistics initiatives, including IFCAP, AEMS/MERS, VALIP, Nuvolo/ServiceNow, or EHRM/FMBT integration programs.
Familiarity with AI-assisted software development lifecycle tools and governance is an advantage.
Strong executive leadership, strategic planning, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, manage dependencies, address risks, and make sound decisions in complex delivery environments.
Strong financial and contract management capabilities, with a customer-focused approach to the federal healthcare mission.
Ability to work at a computer for extended periods and travel within the continental United States as required.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

Drive delivery of cross-team programs that support one or more Technical Solutions teams — coordinating stakeholders, dependencies, and timelines to keep work on track from kickoff through delivery.

Establish and maintain program management fundamentals — project trackers, status updates, risk logs — so stakeholders always have visibility into progress and blockers.

Growth-Oriented: Developing skill in giving constructive, empathetic feedback; may support the onboarding or mentorship of newer team members.
Technical Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent industry experience.

Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the primary bridge aligning local country executive leadership, plant leads, legacy DIG functional counterparts, and central/regional technical build teams.

Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills

Prior proven track record in articulating a business need and exploring suitable options with making of recommendation as to most appropriate solution to best meet the business need.
Understanding of contract management principles and service level agreements
Experience with SAP, SYSPRO, and JDE is considered a strong advantage, enabling the successful candidate to contribute effectively within complex enterprise system environments and enhance overall project outcomes.

Business Need Understanding and Solution Selection

Partner with key Divisional Stakeholders to understand Divisional business needs and overall strategy.

Project Management

Direct and manage project development from beginning to end according to project management principles.
Define project scope, goals and deliverables that support business goals in collaboration with senior / Executive management and business stakeholders.

Data & Transformation Project Manager, EMEA (French language)

Job Description Summary

Job Description Summary

Reporting to the Head of Data Operations EMEA, you will contribute to the transformation and enhancement of the Group's real estate data capabilities across Europe.

You will lead cross-functional projects involving Research, Business Intelligence, Data Operations, and various Cushman & Wakefield business lines. In a context of innovation and accelerating adoption of artificial intelligence, you will play a key role in improving tools, processes, and data quality across the full data lifecycle — from data entry and capture, through reporting, to how business teams consume and act on data.

Job Description

Role Purpose:

Reporting to the Head of Data Operations EMEA, you will contribute to the transformation and enhancement of the Group's real estate data capabilities across Europe.

You will lead cross-functional projects involving Research, Business Intelligence, Data Operations, and various Cushman & Wakefield business lines. In a context of innovation and accelerating adoption of artificial intelligence, you will play a key role in improving tools, processes, and data quality across the full data lifecycle — from data entry and capture, through reporting, to how business teams consume and act on data.

Acting as a key liaison between real estate business teams and Data teams, you will drive both the technical and human sides of transformation: designing better data processes and tools, and ensuring their successful adoption across the organization through structured change management.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Data projects across the EMEA region, including initiatives leveraging Artificial Intelligence and automation.
Lead and deliver innovation and transformation projects, from scoping through to measurable business impact.

Structure and maximize the value of real estate data used by Business, Research, and Transaction Services teams.
Improve the end-to-end data lifecycle, from data entry and capture, to reporting, to how Research, Business, and BI teams consume and act on data.
Manage and continuously improve data quality, investigating, validating, and resolving issues independently.
Support the deployment of new tools and processes across the organization, with structured change management: training, communication plans, and stakeholder alignment.
Anticipate and manage resistance to change, adapting rollout approaches to different business lines and levels of data maturity.
Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with Research, Data, Innovation, and Business teams across France and the wider EMEA region.
Communicate project progress, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders and non-technical audiences, including steering committee reporting.

Experience in leading independently transformation or change management projects, including tool/process adoption across multiple stakeholder groups.
Solid understanding of data models and structures, with working knowledge of SQL to query, validate, and troubleshoot data independently.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical data issues into clear, business-relevant language.
Genuine curiosity for automation and AI, with a track record of identifying and piloting practical use cases (e.g., workflow automation, AI-assisted data entry/QA, RPA)
Excellent organizational and coordination skills; comfortable managing multiple projects in parallel.
Outstanding interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work effectively in an international and multicultural environment.
Mandatory frech language Professional English (B2-C1), valuable other european languange
Prior experience managing or mentoring junior data/analytics staff.
Good understanding of the French commercial real estate market.
Familiarity with business intelligence and data analytics tools (i.e Power BI, SQL, Power Automate).

Project management certification (Agile, PRINCE2, PMP, or equivalent)

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Technical Program Management Team

The Technical Program Management team at Affirm operates at the intersection of strategy, product, and engineering execution. We are versatile operators and trusted strategic partners who drive complex initiatives, design our planning engines, and architect operational frameworks that power the technology behind Affirm's business. Guided by our commitment to putting the customer first and pushing the envelope, we elevate how teams collaborate, resolve critical tradeoffs, and turn high-level vision into scalable reality.

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to oversee high visibility planning programs for our teams and help streamline our processes for building and delivering great customer and merchant products. As our products scale in complexity to meet our accelerating business and expanding product lines, our business and technology process management practices need to scale with it. In this role, you will work closely with engineering, product, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to align efforts with goals, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive change initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Drive complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible transformation & operational programs in service of our team’s mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives
Coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across the company to drive alignment on strategy, priorities, and key decisions.
Implement lean processes and drive towards better ways of working to realize value from planning, ask questions that clarify priorities and push the team to be effective, and build a culture of continuous iteration and improvement
Establish and run data-driven operational frameworks to view portfolio performance against OKRs, accelerate value realization by enabling right investment decisions, influence and train teams on more effective ways of working, and create excitement around change to increase adoption
Develop communication strategies to ensure critical information flows seamlessly across the organization
Partner with cross-functional teams to plan change requirements, identify risks, manage dependencies, and establish tools and forums to drive clarity and efficiency
Identify and distill needs, experiment with new ideas to address systemic inefficiencies and bring transparency, visibility, alignment, and promote accountability across the organization

What We Look For

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
8 years of proven experience managing programs, processes, and change management in a technology-focused environment
Strong technical background with a deep understanding of software development processes
Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams
Obsesses over getting the details right but knows how to make tradeoff decisions
Strong stakeholder management with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams
Track record of successfully implementing frameworks at scale and building relationships in a remote friendly culture
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and consulting skills
Passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better
Prior experience in FinTech, Payments or Commerce is a plus.

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

jobs.title: Market Intelligence Manager | Commercial Strategy
jobs.description:
At Instabee, we’re bringing together three of the Nordics' most loved delivery brands—Instabox, Porterbuddy, and Budbee—to build the future of European e-commerce delivery. Sweden is our innovation hub: the home market where we test bold ideas, build scalable models, and set the standard for the rest of Europe.

We are growing fast, and with scale comes complexity. We’re looking for a curious, collaborative, and analytical Market Intelligence Manager to step in, own our market knowledge, and help shape our strategic growth. Beyond your technical expertise, we are looking for someone with the ambition and potential to develop alongside Instabee and take on broader responsibilities over time.

The Role

As our Market Intelligence Manager at Instabee, you will be the owner of our market knowledge across all our markets: Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands and Belgium.

You will play a vital role in tracking the rapid developments of the e-commerce landscape, ensuring our commercial teams have a clear view of our performance across both current and potential customers. This includes identifying new targets, building pipeline, tracking existing portfolios, and reporting key business metrics such as market share and category growth.

This position is perfect for someone who loves to combine "detective work" with technical execution. You will have a unique opportunity to own our commercial data, build and maintain market models, and experiment with AI agents to automate our intelligence gathering. You will gain firsthand experience in a fast-paced, tech-based scale-up where your insights directly impact our growth trajectory.

Key Responsibilities

Landscape & Competitor Intelligence: Map the evolving e-commerce ecosystem, analyze market share, perform win/loss analyses, and keep our teams informed on regional and competitor strategies (products, pricing, positioning, and financial moves).
Market Modeling & Data Ownership: Build, refine, and maintain market models and commercial data to serve as the foundation for commercial decision making. Set up automated data collection flows using AI for e.g. web scraping, desktop research, and external sources.
Strategic Partnership & Workshops: Act as a trusted partner to sales leaders and key stakeholders. Translate complex data into actionable sales leads, deliver clear insights, and facilitate interactive team workshops.
Technical Bridge & Systems: Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) to our Data Platform and Sales tech teams to ensure connections to our Salesforce, and Snowflake setups.
Visualization & Dashboards: Design and maintain intuitive dashboards and present insights for senior stakeholders to make intelligence accessible across the business.

What We Are Looking For

Skills

We value diverse backgrounds and fresh perspectives. While no candidate will check every single box, we are looking for someone who brings a strong combination of the following skills and qualities:

Background: A couple of years of experience in management consulting, scale-ups/startups, or an analytical commercial role.
Analytical Skills: Advanced capability in Excel/Google Sheets with an ability to identify clear signals within complex datasets.
Technical Toolbox: Experience with (or a strong desire to learn) SQL and Salesforce.
Curiosity for Innovation: Genuine interest in using AI tools and automation to optimize workflows and scale intelligence.
Project Leadership: Proven ability to take initiatives from early-stage ideas through to completed deliverables and implemented systems.
Mindset & Style: Adaptable, resourceful, and supportive. You are a strong communicator, a helpful teammate, and someone who thrives in a fast-changing environment.
Education & Languages: University degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field. Fluency in English is required; Swedish is a strong bonus.

Life at Instabee & What We Offer

We believe that high performance thrives in a supportive, flexible, and fun environment. Joining Instabee means joining a close-knit team that values every individual’s perspective.

Highlights Of Working With Us

🏢 Brand-New Office
: More Space for Our Brilliant People. Soon moving into our new Stockholm HQ, designed to bring our people together to collaborate, connect, create and deliver.

🏓 Fun & Games:
Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and a private Karaoke Room.

👶 Parental Top-Up:
6 months of parental pay support so you can focus on your family.

🎂 Birthday Off:
Enjoy your special day on us with an extra day off every year.

⏰ Flexible Hybrid Setup:
Working hours designed to adapt to your life.

Diversity & Inclusion

Instabee is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome applicants of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences.

Ready to build the future of e-commerce with us? Apply today — we look forward to meeting you!

Good to know

We believe in fair, objective, and inclusive recruitment. To look beyond just a CV and better understand your potential, our process includes a short, science-backed assessment via Alva Labs.

As trust and safety are key to our culture and business, we also carry out a standard background check through Svensk Bakgrundsanalys before final offers are made. Everything is treated with strict confidentiality, and we are happy to answer any questions along the way.

Formed in 2022 through the merger of Budbee and Instabox (uniting the Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy brands), Instabee provides seamless e-commerce deliveries to millions of consumers. We are growing quickly across the Nordics and continental Europe, building cutting-edge logistics technology that handles millions of parcels each week.

As a Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst on Target’s Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) team, you will support the identification, collection, analysis, production, and dissemination of intelligence on cyber threat activity that may pose a risk to Target. This role contributes to strategic, operational, and tactical intelligence objectives by converting threat reporting, technical indicators, behavioral observations, and internal security context into insights that inform detection, response, and risk prioritization.

jobs.description:
What you'll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we're the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare "win win" — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

About the role:

We are seeking an exceptional AI-Native Data Analyst to join Garner and drive how data shapes business decisions at scale. You'll be the person the business trusts to turn fuzzy questions into the metrics, dashboards, and deep-dive analyses that decisions actually get made on — owning that work end-to-end.

Where you will work:

This role will be based in our New York City office (in the Financial District). You must be willing to work in the office 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

What you will do:

Own KPIs and dashboards end-to-end.
Build, maintain, and govern key KPIs and dashboards across business domains, managing the full lifecycle of analytics projects from scoping to delivery.
Be a thought partner on measurement.
Partner with stakeholders to define how success is measured across Garner's products and operations.
Build scalable data pipelines.
Collaborate with the data engineering team to create maintainable pipelines that power reliable reporting.
Develop deep domain expertise.
Build a strong understanding of your analytical domain so you can independently drive meaningful insights.
Close reporting gaps.
Identify where coverage is missing and proactively develop new dashboards and insights to fill them.
Raise the bar on data practices.
Advocate for best practices in visualization, documentation, metric consistency, and stakeholder communication across teams.
Answer high-stakes, ambiguous questions.
Run deep-dive investigations into complex business problems — the kind of analysis leadership uses to make strategic calls.

The ideal candidate has:

5+ years
of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a similar data-centric role.
Cross-functional translation.
Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into data-driven solutions and to work effectively with non-technical stakeholders.
Autonomy and ownership.
Comfortable working independently and owning reporting projects end-to-end.
Automation mindset.
Attention to detail with a bias toward automation and scalability over one-off work.
AI Nativity.
Comfort with and excitement about building analytics, building dashboards, and validating results by harnessing the power of AI agents.
Making data accessible
. A track record of getting stakeholders trustworthy, self-serve access to the information they need. Experience with a BI/visualization tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) helps — but the outcome matters more than the specific tool.
Modern data stack.

A desire to be part of a high-performing, mission-driven team that operates with intense urgency, a strong sense of individual accountability, and a commitment to authentic feedback.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing company in a transformative role, helping shape the future of healthcare.

What you'll get here:

You'll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You'll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you'll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It's demanding by design. Job Description

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist
to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.

Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.*

Your daily adventure:

Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.
Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.

Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights.

Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team.

Qualifications

Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.
3+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry.
Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis.
Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.
Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).
Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.
Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.
Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.
Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.
Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.

Nice to Have:

Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.
Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences).
Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).
Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.
Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.
Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.

jobs.title: Senior Environmental Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

At UES, we’re a team of more than 4,000 engineers, scientists, geologists, inspectors, technicians, and drillers united by a shared purpose—to make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. As a national leader in geotechnical engineering, environmental consulting, and materials testing and inspection, we collaborate on transformative projects across transportation, energy, water, healthcare, and more. Learn more about the benefits of joining Team UES and our core values at careers.teamues.com.

Position Overview

The Senior Geologist serves as a technical expert and project lead on complex environmental and geological assignments. This role oversees field teams, reviews technical deliverables, and ensures the highest standards of quality, safety, and compliance. The Senior Geologist also mentors junior geologists and provides strategic input into proposal development and project planning.

The Senior Environmental Project Manager will be responsible for overall project management of Phase I/II Environmental Site Assessments, which may include various types of properties such as undeveloped land, agricultural, residential, multi-family, retail, and commercial/industrial. Responsible for completion and overall success of the project, including resource allocation, project scheduling, budgeting, and forecasting. Lead project meetings, generate reports, and update both the project team and client on progress. Set priorities, assign tasks, and coordinate staff to achieve project goals and milestones. May also serve as the primary client contact, ensuring deliverables meet expectations.

Responsibilities

Lead and oversee complex site investigations, remediation efforts, and regulatory compliance activities.
Perform and review detailed data interpretation, modeling, and advanced geologic or hydrogeologic analysis.
Prepare, review, and sign off on technical reports, including regulatory submittals and risk assessments.
Mentor and train junior geologists in field techniques, reporting, and regulatory understanding.
Manage client relationships and act as a technical point of contact on projects.
Develop scopes of work, schedules, and budgets for proposals and ongoing projects.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and regulatory agencies to ensure project success.
Evaluate and implement process improvements to enhance safety, efficiency, and technical quality.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Hydrogeology, or Environmental Science; Master’s degree preferred.
8+ years of progressive experience in environmental site investigation, remediation, or regulatory compliance
FG certification required; Professional Geologist (PG) license strongly preferred or required based on state
OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER certification and current refresher
valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
Expertise in environmental regulations, risk-based remediation strategies, and project lifecycle management.
Advanced proficiency in field instrumentation, data interpretation, geologic modeling, and QA/QC processes
Proven experience leading technical teams, mentoring junior staff, and managing client relationships
Strong track record of writing, reviewing, and signing off on regulatory submittals, proposals, and reports.
Strategic thinking, project scoping, and budgeting experience preferred.

Travel Requirements

This position requires moderate travel, approximately up to 20% to 40% of the time, in support of business

objectives and client engagements. Travel may be both scheduled and on short notice, depending on

project needs. Destinations typically include job sites, field locations, or regional offices, where work may

be conducted in outdoor or operational environments. Adherence to all company safety protocols and

use of PPE is required during travel and on-site work.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

This position primarily works in an outdoor work environment, regularly exposed to varying field conditions, including:
Sites that may not be accessible by vehicle, requiring travel on foot through wetlands, swamps, grasslands, fields, and other uneven or rugged terrain with natural and man-made obstacles such as sand, brush, and debris.
Moderate to loud noise levels, common in active construction and industrial environments.
Exposure to environmental elements including dirt, dust, sun, heat, humidity, and adverse weather conditions.

The physical requirements for this position may include and are not limited to:
Ability to lift and/or carry 35 to 75 lbs. up to 75 feet, involving regular repetitive motion.
Ability to stand, walk, drive, and operate equipment for extended periods.
Frequent use of hands and arms for typing, handling tools, and operating equipment.
Ability to bend, twist, reach, stoop, pull, kneel, climb, balance, lift, carry, and push as required for fieldwork and inspections.
Ability to speak and hear effectively to communicate in noisy environments and with project teams.
Ability to use your senses to see (including close, distant, and peripheral vison, depth vision, and ability to focus) smell, hear, touch (use hands to reach climb or balance, crouch, stoop, crawl, kneel and sit)
