jobs.description:
Job Overview:

Risk & Research Analyst, Risk Management, Keurig Trading

Join Keurig Trading’s Risk Management team in a data and information centric role supporting commodity risk decisions through rigorous analysis, reporting, modeling, and market research. The Risk & Research Analyst transforms internal business data and external market intelligence into reliable insights, forecasts, and decision-support materials. Working closely with Risk Management, Sourcing, Procurement, Supply Chain Finance, Treasury, and other business partners, this role strengthens the quality, consistency, and transparency of risk information.

This position will be based in Lausanne, Switzerland, and will report to the Senior Director, Commodity Risk Management at Keurig Trading.

What you will do:

Market data, research and modeling
Analyze commodity market fundamentals, price drivers, supply-demand dynamics, and macroeconomic trends to identify emerging risks, scenarios, and business implications.
Develop, maintain, and enhance commodity supply-demand, pricing, cost, exposure, and forecasting models using internal business data and external market intelligence.
Collect, validate, structure, and synthesize information from industry research, market data providers, brokers, counterparties, and public sources.
Apply quantitative, statistical, and scenario-based analysis to improve market views, forecasts, risk assessments, and hedging decision support.
Risk analytics, reporting and decision support
Produce accurate and timely daily, weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting on commodity exposures, coverage levels, market movements, pricing risk, and hedge performance.
Build and maintain analytical dashboards, management reports, data visualizations, and presentation materials that clearly communicate key trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Perform variance, sensitivity, trend, and scenario analysis to explain changes in exposure, market value, forecast cost, and risk position.
Translate complex datasets and market information into concise insights, business implications, and actionable recommendations for stakeholders and senior leadership.
Support recurring planning, forecasting, and performance-review processes by providing consistent analytical inputs and well-documented assumptions.
Maintain reliable data models, source files, reporting logic, and documentation to support consistent and reproducible analysis across Risk Management activities.
Validate and reconcile market data, transactions, positions, valuations, forecasts, and counterparty information, investigating and resolving data discrepancies in a timely manner.
Partner with Controlling, Treasury, Procurement, Accounting, and Technology teams to strengthen the integrity of market pricing, risk reporting, management information, and hedge-accounting inputs.
Contribute to the development and optimization of risk management systems, analytical tools, reporting solutions, and automated workflows.
Identify opportunities to improve data accessibility, reporting efficiency, model accuracy, transparency, controls, and user experience.
Develop and maintain clear process documentation, model assumptions, data definitions, controls, and audit evidence.
Support the enhancement of commodity risk methodologies, analytical frameworks, key performance indicators, and governance standards.
Participate in cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives requiring commodity market, risk, financial, or data analysis.

Additional responsibilities:

Prepare high-quality analyses, presentations, and briefing materials for meetings with Finance, Procurement, Commercial, Supply Chain, and senior leadership stakeholders.
Monitor open coffee purchase commitments and unpriced exposures, assist in execution of approved coffee price fixations under direction.
Support internal and external audits by maintaining appropriate documentation, data lineage, evidence, and process controls.
Develop collaborative and professional relationships with internal stakeholders, market data providers, brokers, financial counterparties, and external research partners.
Build organizational understanding of commodity markets, analytical outputs, risk measures, and reporting through clear guidance, training, and knowledge sharing.
Conduct all activities in accordance with company values, ethical standards, centralized procurement and risk management policies, regulatory requirements, internal controls, and applicable Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements.

Requirements:

What you must have:

Valid Swiss work permit
Fluency in the English language is required
Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, data analytics, engineering, supply chain, or a related field.
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in market research, risk analysis, financial analysis, data analytics, commodities, or a similar field.
Experience in commodity market research, supply-demand modeling, forecasting, economics, or exposure analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to data accuracy, consistency, and detail under time pressure.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with experience creating models, management reports, and data visualizations.
Ability to translate complex data and market information into clear, concise insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Positive, motivated team player who can manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, multinational, and cross-functional environment.

Preferred skills:

Advanced degree in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, data analytics, engineering, or a related discipline.
Knowledge of market information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters and experience evaluating external data sources.
Experience with risk management, enterprise reporting, data visualization, or business intelligence systems.
Working knowledge of commodity risk management concepts, exposure measurement, hedging instruments, and derivatives.
Experience with data automation or analytical tools such as Power BI, SQL, Python, VBA, macros, or similar technologies.
Experience with SAP and integrating financial, procurement, market, or operational data into analytical reporting.

Company Overview:

Keurig Dr Pepper (Nasdaq: KDP) is a leading beverage company with more than 150 owned, licensed and partner brands that meet a wide range of needs and occasions. Our North American refreshment beverage business holds leadership positions across carbonated soft drinks, water, juice and mixers with a portfolio of iconic brands such as Dr Pepper®, Canada Dry®, Mott’s®, Peñafiel®, GHOST®, Snapple®, Clamato® and Core Hydration®. Our global coffee business spans more than 100 markets and includes the leading Keurig® single‑serve brewing system in the U.S. and Canada, along with powerhouse brands such as Peet’s, L’OR and Jacobs, and other regional coffee leaders. Our more than 50,000 employees aim to enhance the experience of every beverage and coffee occasion while making a positive impact for people, communities and the planet.

We strive to be an employer of choice, providing a culture and opportunities that empower our team to grow and develop. We offer robust benefits to support your health and wellness as well as your personal and financial well-being. Whatever your area of expertise, at KDP you can be a part of a team that’s proud of its brands, partnerships, innovation and growth. Will you join us?

The Procurement Enablement & Operations Analyst leads two areas 1) source-to-pay process: Procurement Enablement (the policies, systems, data, KPIs and training that let the business buy correctly) and 2) Operational Procurement (the day-to-day execution of vendor onboarding, purchase requisition (PR) to purchase order (PO) conversion, outline agreements and compliance reporting).

The analyst understands how procurement decisions affect cost, cash, supply continuity and financial controls, and how those processes are built in SAP S/4HANA and Ariba. The role sets up the procurement KPI framework (retro spend, vendor onboarding etc), measures and enforces compliance, and drives corrective actions with Buyers, requisitioners, suppliers, AP, Finance, IT and Operations. Procurement Enablement

Translate procurement policy and approval rules (delegation of authority, contract requirements) into clear processes, system workflows and release strategies in SAP/Ariba)
Design and maintain buying channels (catalogs, SAP contracts, scheduling agreements, spot buys) so requisitioners are guided to the right supplier, price and approval path
Write and maintain procurement procedures, work instructions, desk guides and training; onboard and train requisitioners, buyers and approvers on policy and system use

Identify and deliver simplification and automation opportunities (touchless POs, approval routing, catalogs, workflow, self-service reporting) with IT, AP and Finance
Define rules to tackle tail spend and reduce supplier onboarding.

Operational Procurement

Procurement compliance reporting: approval-policy adherence, contract coverage, vendor master changes and segregation-of-duties conflicts
Support internal and external audits and reporting requirements.

Business & System Acumen

Understand how procurement links to planning/MRP, receiving, Inventory, AP, Finance, and how a change in one area affects the others

Champion disciplined procurement execution and governance across plants, projects and business functions

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Information Systems or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience

Senior Strategic Data Analyst, Growth & Placement

Austin, TX (Onsite 4 days per week)

Note: This is a full-time role. We do not offer C2C or C2H employment and are not able to sponsor visas for this position.

About Acrisure

Acrisure is a global fintech leader empowering millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human expertise together, we connect clients with customized solutions across insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services, and more. In the last twelve years, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to almost $5 billion and employs over 19,000 colleagues in more than 20 countries.

The Role

Acrisure's Growth & Placement Analytics team supporting the executive leadership of our North America Insurance business operates at the intersection of data and business strategy, translating complex data assets into decisions that drive revenue and operational performance. As a Senior Strategic Data Analyst on the Growth & Placement pod, you will operate as a trusted senior individual contributor owning strategically ambiguous, high-stakes analytical questions facing NAI leadership and driving them from initial framing through executive-ready recommendation.

This is not a role where the questions are handed to you. You will independently identify what the business needs to understand, structure the analytical approach, and shape the agenda in partnership with senior executives. Your findings will directly inform decisions with enterprise-wide impact, and the analytical products you build will be used across NAI leadership, operating teams, and downstream analytical functions.

Beyond delivery, you will set the standard for analytical rigor within the team. This is a thought-leadership role: you establish the patterns others follow — how we frame ambiguous problems, how we communicate data limitations, how we integrate AI tooling into production analytical workflows without compromising trust. You are expected to raise the ceiling of what the team can do.

Acrisure is investing significantly in its data infrastructure, most visibly through the adoption of Palantir Foundry as our enterprise analytics and application platform. You will have the autonomy and expectation to shape how those investments translate into analytical value for the business, and to architect the data assets required to answer questions that don't yet have precedent.

How You'll Drive Impact:

Own the analytical framing of the most strategically important and ambiguous questions facing NAI leadership — deciding what merits investigation, defining the approach, and driving the work from problem definition through executive-ready recommendation with minimal oversight.
Design and deliver enterprise-scale analytical products end-to-end — from metric definition and data modeling through self-service delivery — that serve multiple audiences across NAI leadership, operating teams, and downstream analytical functions.
Independently engage senior executive stakeholders to shape the analytical agenda rather than react to it, and to translate ambiguous business questions into structured, defensible answers.
Lead multi-quarter analytical initiatives that require sustained investigation, integration of insights across functions, and pattern recognition across large, multi-source datasets.
Set the standard for analytical rigor across the team, establishing patterns for how we frame problems, communicate data limitations, and build analytical trust with executive audiences.
Write and optimize expert-level SQL against Palantir Foundry; architect the data models and pipelines required to support new categories of analysis; extend dbt models and Palantir Ontology objects where the analysis demands it.
Architect and productionize AI-augmented analytical workflows such as Generative AI classification pipelines and integrated analysis that scale analytical capacity while preserving rigorous verification standards. You define what "trustworthy" looks like when AI is in the workflow.
Champion intellectual honesty about what the data does and doesn't support — setting the tone for the team on when to say "we don't know yet" and how to make that observation actionable rather than paralyzing.

You May Be a Fit If You Have:

5–8 years of professional experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a strategy-adjacent analytics role, with a clear trajectory of increasing scope and autonomy over that time.
Expert command of SQL: you write complex analytical queries fluently across window functions, CTEs, and multi-table joins; you optimize your own queries; and you can architect data logic that others build on.
A demonstrable track record of owning end-to-end analytical products that serve broad stakeholder populations — from metric definition and data modeling through self-service delivery, not just contributing to work owned by others.
Deep experience with a modern cloud data warehouse and hands-on data modeling experience with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework.
Proven ability to independently frame ambiguous business problems, structure the analytical approach, and drive multi-quarter initiatives with minimal oversight.
Executive-grade communication — you can walk into a C-suite conversation, set the terms of the discussion, and defend your analytical position in real time. Written and verbal fluency at that altitude are both expected.
The intellectual honesty and confidence to say 'the data doesn't fully answer this question, and here's why' — and to make that observation productive rather than deflating.
Experience integrating AI or ML into analytical workflows at production quality — for example, Gen AI classification pipelines, prompt-engineered analytical automation, or Claude/LLM-integrated analytical products.
Experience with a BI or visualization tool (Tableau, Power BI) and a track record of delivering to multiple audiences from a single data foundation.
A genuine interest in developing deep expertise in Palantir Foundry and the intellectual openness to become one of the team's Foundry authorities.
A skeptic's relationship with AI tools — you use them, you benefit from them, but you validate their outputs rigorously before letting them inform business decisions or ship to production.
A bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical field, or equivalent professional experience. Advanced degrees in analytics, data science, or a related field are welcomed but not required.

Nice to Have:

Direct hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry, including Ontology modeling or Workshop application development.
Python proficiency, particularly for analytical automation, data transformation, or ML/AI pipeline development.
Experience in insurance, financial services, or other complex B2B commercial environments.
Prior experience directly presenting findings to C-suite audiences and defending analytical recommendations in executive forums.
Experience establishing analytical standards, playbooks, or reusable patterns adopted by a broader analytics team.
Exposure to agile development practices, Git-based workflows, and project tracking tools like Jira.

Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership.

Our Data, Analytics & Insights team is expanding, and we're opening three analytical ownership roles at once: Strategy & Commercial, Customer Care, and Shipping & Logistics.

Strong SQL proficiency and comfort working with large, complex datasets — you can build the query and explain what the result means for the business in the same breath

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodation, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting edge technology that connects travelers with more than 2.5 million accommodations globally. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 4,000+ talents coming from 90+ different nationalities foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enabling our customers to experience the world.
The Opportunity:

As an analyst, you will have the exciting opportunity to design and develop data and AI capabilities that drive the team’s capabilities. In this role, you’ll collaborate across diverse functional teams to ensure our data and AI solutions truly meet business needs. You’ll find new opportunities to improve workflows using AI or other data solutions. You’ll also be working on special initiatives as the data and AI expert.

Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and serve data from Agoda Systems and third‑party tools and logs.

Collaborate with stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities for automation, intelligent reporting, data analysis, documentation, and internal process improvement.
Evaluate AI outputs for quality, accuracy, privacy, usability, and alignment with organizational requirements.
Helping build and maintain the team’s AI infrastructure and become a thought leader in Agoda

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

Minimum 2 years experience working in a business analysis, data analysis, reporting or data engineering. Strong internship experience will also be considered. 

Bachelor’s Degree or higher in computer sciences, engineering, mathematics, statistics, data science or a related degree program.
Interpret novel data sources to improve our understanding of our business position and identify new opportunities.
Expert domain of data analysis and data visualization tools and software such as Excel, SQL, Tableau, Python, R, or similar
Expertise or interest in developing AI solutions and implementing governance models. 
Working proficiency in XML, data modelling, data architecture & components
Analytical mindset, with proven track record in using data to measure performance and make decisions
Excellent problem-solving skills including the ability to analyze and resolve complex problems using data
Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment
Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written), with proven ability to convey complex messages clearly and with conviction
Team player with strong interpersonal, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.
Based in the GTA to attend ad-hoc team functions. 

Ability to work some nights to collaborate with Bangkok based teams.

MBA or Masters in a quantitative subject (computer science, data science, analytics, mathematics, engineering, science, economics and finance etc.)
Experience in NLP, image processing and/or recommendation systems 
Hands on experience in data engineering, working with big data framework like Spark/Hadoop 
Experience in data science for e-commerce and/or OTA

About the role:

The Insights and Product Analytics team (IPA) organization is responsible for business performance of all research products and performs analysis related to all aspects of Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights business unit. The Retention Analytics and Applied IVR team within IPA is at the forefront of harnessing the latest analytics and AI advancements to define paths to higher client retention. The team leads analytics across several fronts spanning content, interactions, conferences and all other Gartner client facing assets. The team also leads critical pillars like associate performance analytics, budget and financial analysis (in partnership with the finance organization).

We are looking for Associate Data Analyst who has a passion for analytical problem solving to be part of our growing team. This individual will solve a wide range of problems related to content analytics, interaction and events analytics, demand sensing, staffing models, cost reporting, automation, expert performance analytics, standard reporting, and ad-hoc analytics. Individuals in this role will work closely with IPA leadership to structure problems, identify data sources, perform analysis, and communicate findings. Strong performers will build skills to independently own project workstreams and interact with stakeholders. Projects will include a mix of team problem solving and independent problem solving. Projects will also involve automation and collaboration with the Information Technology team.

What you’ll do:

Own problem structuring, analysis and implementation of strategic initiatives and key, cross-organizational deliverables.
Partner with data scientist and data engineering teams to develop scalable and advanced analytics-based solutions that directly help with improved client retention.
Analyze large amounts of data to derive business insights
Play a key role in projects centered around measuring retention impact of all forms of Gartner assets, creating a path to continuous evolution of Gartner’s content, interactions, and other client offering.
Interact with business leaders to understand their pain areas and build solutions catering to their needs.

What you’ll need:

Experience: 0-1 years of experience involving analysis of large volumes of data with strong hands-on experience with analytical tools. Ability to gather, analyze, restructure, identify and articulate insights from qualitative and quantitative data.
Education: Bachelor’s Degree, preferably with quantitative concentration (e.g., statistics, data science, mathematics, engineering, operational research, computer science, or economics).
Exceptional problem solving: Proven track record of solving complex problems, thinking creatively, and using data to tell a story.
Leadership: Shown ability to engage teams and key stakeholders.
Technical competency: Advanced Excel and PowerPoint. SQL, Python/R, Databricks, Basics of Data Science
Collaboration: Strong collaboration and influencing.
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication as well as the ability to work independently.
Location: Gartner offers a hybrid, flexible environment, with remote work that allows associates great flexibility to work from home, and opportunities to connect with colleagues for moments that matter on-site. Candidates that apply will need to reside within a reasonable proximity to a Gartner’s Centers of Excellence office location (Gurgaon)

What you will get:

Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, Group Medical Insurance, Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more!
Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces diversity
Professional development and unlimited growth opportunities

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

jobs.title: Marketing Data Analyst

N-iX is a software engineering company with around 2,400 engineers. We were founded in Lviv in 2002, we are headquartered in Malta, and we work with clients across the US, the UK, and the DACH region. We help enterprise technology leaders build and modernize software, data, cloud, and embedded systems, and we position ourselves as a Pragmatic AI Software Engineering partner.
Our go-to-market is inbound-led. Most of our new business starts on our website, and our business development team is small. That means marketing data is not a reporting exercise for us. It is how the company decides where to invest.

Why this role exists

We need one person who owns the numbers behind marketing and turns them into decisions. You will connect website behavior, channel performance, and pipeline outcomes into a single view, explain what is driving change, and recommend what we should do next.
You will work directly with the CMO and present to the N-iX leadership team. The work you produce will shape budget allocation, channel strategy, and the annual marketing plan. You will partner with paid search, organic search and content, ABM and events, and brand and PR leads in the marketing team to set targets and measure results. You will also collaborate with Sales, Business Development, Finance, and Delivery to align on pipeline definitions and shared metrics

What you will do:

Pipeline and performance analytics

Own marketing pipeline reporting from first visit to qualified opportunity and closed revenue.
Analyze performance by channel, campaign, content asset, region, and persona, and identify which activities produce qualified pipeline from our ICP (CTO, CIO, and VP Engineering buyers at companies with 500+ employees).
Separate pipeline volume from pipeline quality, and track conversion and velocity at each funnel stage.
Build and maintain the weekly qualified pipeline view used in leadership meetings, with written commentary that explains the movement, not only the figures.
Run quarterly reviews of channel mix and spend efficiency, and propose where to shift budget.

Web and digital analytics

Treat the website as our primary revenue channel. Measure and improve how visitors move from landing page to conversion.
Act as the team's GA4 expert, and keep website tracking accurate as the site and campaigns change.
Track paid search, organic search, ABM, events, and social performance in a consistent framework so the team can compare channels fairly.
Design and analyze experiments on pages, forms, and campaigns, and report results with clear confidence levels.

Modeling and forecasting

Use statistical methods such as segmentation, regression, and predictive modeling to find patterns in large marketing and sales datasets.
Build pipeline and lead volume forecasts using coverage ratios and cohort-based methods to support quarterly planning.
Develop and maintain an attribution approach that fits a long, multi-touch B2B buying cycle. Explain the trade-offs between models, such as first-touch and last-touch, so stakeholders understand what the numbers can and cannot tell them.

KPI governance and data quality

Own the reporting data model that joins CRM, web analytics, and ad platform data in our warehouse.
Build data quality checks and reconciliation steps that catch anomalies before they reach a dashboard.
When data is wrong, find the cause at the source and fix it with the system owner, rather than patching the report.
Work with data engineering, sales operations, and IT to keep tracking, CRM data, and reporting accurate and current.

Storytelling and leadership reporting

Explain why performance changed, in plain language, for executives, marketers, and sales leaders.
Build dashboards and visuals that make trends easy to read at a glance.
Frame every insight against company goals: what it means, what the risk or opportunity is, and what you recommend.

Automation, AI, and self-service

Use AI tools such as Claude as a default part of how you query, model, analyze, and document, not as an occasional experiment.
Automate recurring reports so your time goes to analysis, not assembly.
Build self-service reporting so the marketing team can answer routine performance questions without a custom request.

What you bring

Required:

5+ years in professional analytics, including 3+ years in marketing or revenue operations at a B2B SaaS, technology services, or IT consulting company.
English level - Upper Intermediate or higher
Proven track record of presenting insights through storytelling to senior leaders and driving decision-making changes.
Strong SQL and working proficiency in Python or R, with applied statistics experience such as predictive modeling or causal inference.
Advanced GA4 experience, plus hands-on experience with a CRM (Salesforce preferred) and paid media platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads).
Working knowledge of the CRM object model (leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, campaigns) and how funnel metrics map onto it.
Fluency in B2B funnel metrics such as MQL to Target Opportunity conversion, pipeline velocity, and ACV, and an understanding of why each one matters.
Experience building dashboards in a BI tool (Power BI, Looker, Looker Studio, or similar).
Daily use of AI tools in analytical work, with sound judgment about when to trust and when to check the output.
Experience with B2B funnels with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders on the buying side.
A degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research, or Data Science.

Nice to have:

Experience with incrementality testing in B2B, such as holdout or lift tests on paid search and LinkedIn, and an understanding of where methods like media mix modeling do and do not apply at lower data volumes.
Experience building dimensional data models (star or snowflake schemas) in a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery or Snowflake.
Python for automation and data quality scripts.
Experience with intent data, sales engagement, or conversation intelligence platforms.
Familiarity with SEO tools (Ahrefs, Google Ads, Google Search Console) and behavior analytics (Microsoft Clarity or similar)

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Mid
jobs.description:
Overview

Please note that this position is contingent upon the successful award of a contract currently under bid.

Goldbelt Apex, a part of the Healthcare Technology Transformation Group, is a data-focused company dedicated to process and quality in every aspect. As experts in healthcare IT experts, Apex is committed to building systems for healthcare organizations to seamlessly communicate and exchange data across different systems and devices.

Summary:

The Mid-level Data Analyst will support survey and program data analysis, recurring/ad hoc reporting, data quality, system data support, charts/graphs/tables, and analysis of DES and SCAADL program performance.

Personnel are assigned in support of DHHQ in Falls Church, VA, but may work from the contractor facility or remotely when authorized.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

Develop, refine, and generate recurring and ad hoc reports using approved data analysis and reporting software to analyze large datasets from multiple sources.
Analyze DES and SCAADL program data to identify performance trends, population changes, timeliness, process outcomes, quality measures, and other program metrics.
Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad hoc reports in accordance with established program requirements and deadlines.
Develop clear and accurate charts, graphs, tables, and statistical visualizations appropriate to the type and complexity of the data, including scatter plots and other advanced visualizations when appropriate.
Prepare draft DES performance reports addressing population changes, phase and stage timeliness, process outcomes, special interest metrics, and other required measures.
Prepare draft SCAADL performance reports and analyze historical enrollment and participation data to identify trends and support program reporting.
Maintain and update the SCAADL Microsoft Access database and compile data received from Military Departments for analysis and reporting.
Analyze program data and reporting results and provide recommendations for process improvements based on identified trends and findings.
Support IDES satisfaction survey activities by gathering survey outcomes, analyzing results, and preparing reports, graphs, and recommendations for corrective actions.
Assist with the development and modification of MEB, PEB, and Personnel survey instruments and related survey documentation.
Pull MEB and PEB cohorts from the Veteran’s Tracking Application (VTA) and review data for accuracy, completeness, and survey eligibility.
Monitor data quality in program-related systems, identify data errors, and assist with tracking and resolving data quality issues.
Assist with system data support activities, including drafting system change requests, supporting user acceptance testing, and identifying opportunities to improve system capabilities and performance.
Assist with developing and maintaining business process documentation, reporting procedures, and user guidance for program-related systems and processes.
Coordinate with Government personnel and other stakeholders to obtain, validate, and clarify data and reporting requirements.
Provide other support as needed.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and one or more analytical/reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Access, R, Python, or similar
Strong analytical, organizational, and written communication skills

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, information systems, business analytics, computer science, or a related field
3-5 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis, statistical analysis, or reporting
Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources
Experience developing reports, charts, graphs, tables, and data visualizations
Experience performing data validation and identifying data-quality issues
Tier 1/non-sensitive, with the applicable DHA background investigation and suitability requirements.

Preferred Qualifications (Education, Experience, Skills):

Federal, DoD, DHA, healthcare, or military personnel data experience preferred

Pay And Benefits

The salary range for this position is $75,000.00 to $100,000.00 annually.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst (all genders) - Lounge by Zalando - Parental Leave Cover (12 months)
jobs.description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

As a Senior Business Analyst in our Supply Analytics team at Zalando Lounge, you will work alongside the Supply team and leadership toward our vision of acquiring unmatched value-for-money deals that drive Lounge user acquisition, conversion, and retention.

In this role, you will build on your analytical and statistical skills to generate actionable business insights that enable smarter decision-making. You will lead and implement initiatives to develop sustainable reporting solutions and create fact-based insights regarding our partner (supplier) lifecycle and pricing dynamics, from both quantity and quality perspectives. You will actively collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders by sharing relevant context based on the key performance indicators (KPIs) you track, analyze, and embed across the business. To succeed in this role, you should possess a naturally analytical mindset and the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

About Lounge By Zalando

Lounge by Zalando is an online outlet for fashion and lifestyle products in 25 European countries.

We offer our members daily, time-limited sale campaigns with discounts of up to 75% off the recommended retail price.

However, Lounge by Zalando is so much more than discounts. Our strength lies in our focus on fashion: from sought-after labels to niche brands, from famous international names to trendy luxury brands, we make sure to meet the fashion taste of all our customers, who are always on the hunt for the best products at the best prices.

Working with our brand partners, we're pioneering innovative supply-chain and production processes and offer them an impactful and smart solution, creating a new way to shop for fashion - and a new way to sell it.

Our motto: Not your average outlet.

https://www.zalando-lounge.de

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)

Operationalize Business Reporting: Develop a deep understanding of our business processes, tools, and overall data landscape to build, implement, and operationalize reporting focused on Partner insights and Pricing capabilities for Zalando Lounge (connecting inventory, sales, supply, planning, and steering).
Drive Analytical Insights: Formulate and test hypotheses using descriptive, exploratory, and quantitative analyses to generate impactful business insights while identifying emerging risks and strategic opportunities.
Engage Senior Stakeholders: Present complex analytical findings and recommendations to senior internal stakeholders in a visually compelling, easily digestible manner (using Tableau or Databricks) to advance our collective intelligence.
Deliver End-to-End Analytics: Take full accountability for all stages of data analysis, research, and data visualization using narrative storytelling, while leading high-impact Data & Analytics projects and initiatives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with technology and data teams across Zalando to maximize the utility of existing datasets and ensure optimal access to high-value data points.

WE'D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF

Technical Expertise: You are a highly proficient user of Tableau and Databricks, with strong SQL skills (Python is a plus). You work autonomously with these tools and can effectively guide others in using them.
Proven Impact & Domain Knowledge: You have led initiatives or projects that enabled businesses to make high-impact decisions through your insights or developed solutions. Domain expertise in inventory management or the planning and steering of sales and supply is a strong plus.
Education & Experience: You hold a degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Informatics, or a similar quantitative field, paired with 5+ years of professional experience in a similar role (ideally in a fast-paced e-commerce or retail environment). Knowledge of statistical methods is a plus.
Mindset & Adaptability: Collaborators value your drive to make an impact, your ability to spot inefficiencies with a hands-on approach, and your knack for finding simple, efficient solutions to complex challenges. You are proactive and adapt quickly to change while remaining focused on key objectives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: You balance technical acumen with business understanding, excelling at collaborating with commercial stakeholders to generate actionable insights.
Communication & Storytelling: You possess the ability to communicate clearly and concisely, creating engaging narratives around the results of your analyses.

OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.

27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)

INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

Willkommen bei XXXLdigital, wo digitale Innovation echte Wirkung zeigt. Als digitale Organisationseinheit der XXXL-Gruppe widmen wir uns allen Facetten des E-Commerce und stationärem Handel. Du bringst mindestens vier Jahre Berufserfahrung in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Reporting oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit und hast ein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, E-Commerce, Mathematik, Statistik oder einem anderen technischen beziehungsweise analytischen Fach abgeschlossen – alternativ überzeugst du mit vergleichbarer Berufserfahrung

Rohdaten überführst du eigenständig in reportingfähige Datensätze und Datenprodukte, indem du passende Datenmodelle und Datentransformationen entwickelst

Reporting-Projekte planst und koordinierst du, setzt Prioritäten und kommunizierst Ergebnisse adressatengerecht
Datenlogiken und Kennzahlendefinitionen dokumentierst du nachvollziehbar und stellst damit eine einheitliche, verlässliche Qualität sicher

Gesundheit & Wohlfühlen: Gratis Kaffee, Tee, Getränke, frisches Obst und Gemüse sowie vergünstigte Mahlzeiten in der Kantine oder Essenszuschüsse (standortabhängig). Moderne Arbeitsplätze für alle Bedürfnisse

Flexible Work-Life Balance: Genieße flexible Arbeitszeiten und diverse Möglichkeiten für Remote Work
Feiern & Meilensteine: Teamevents und besondere Aufmerksamkeiten für Geburtstage und Jubiläen
Standortspezifische Benefits: Maßgeschneiderte Benefits, die auf die Bedürfnisse der jeweiligen Standorte zugeschnitten sind

Über XXXLdigital

Wir scheuen nicht die Vielfalt – wir feiern sie. Sei du selbst und zeig uns wer du bist!

Dich erwartet ein Jahresbruttogehalt ab 65.000 € – mit der klaren Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung, wenn du durch Erfahrung und Know-how überzeugst. Alles weitere dazu besprechen wir gerne persönlich.

The Sr Client Project Manager is accountable for managing the delivery of projects in compliance with ACI policies and customer contractual commitments. They lead and collaborate with a team to deliver projects of varying levels of complexity (typically between a 6–12-month duration) with minimal supervision. They are responsible for managing multiple projects in parallel, aligned to ACI’s project methodology. They facilitate communication with customers and internal departments to ensure the status of the project are clear, while effectively managing risks, issues and core Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). The Sr Client Project Manager oversees a project from its inception through to its execution and final delivery. They maintain and share schedules while monitoring the project’s budget. Ultimately, they guide projects to successful completion within scope and budget that meets or exceeds quality standard within defined timeframes.
Job Responsibilities:
- • Understands all contractual commitments and ensures these are tracked with the customer.

- • Ensures project scope and baseline to ensure delivery is compliant and organizational standard change control tracking is applied.

- • Monitors the project budget, tracks any changes to the scope or schedule that may impact the budget and provides accurate resource forecasts based on project estimated completion.

- • Develops comprehensive project plans, schedules, agreements and proposals and ensures projects are completed within budget and defined timeframes. Identifies and addresses barriers to goal achievement.

- • Directs all aspects of projects including but not limited to research, analysis, documentation, design/development, testing, negotiation, problem resolution, training, status reporting, implementation, deliverables, project closing and post-rollout review/audit. Ensures all project deliverables are met and delivered to customer in accordance with contractual commitments.

- • Provides accurate project Estimated Time to Completion (ETC) to the revenue accounting team on a monthly basis to ensure precise revenue forecasting

- • Establishes a project governance model to ensure all relevant stakeholders are aware of project statues and assist with resolving escalations.

- • Manages project issues and risks (technical and non-technical) through identification, evaluation, tracking, communication and mediation. Maintains RAID log for projects.

- • Ensures the project team is equipped with the right procedures to deliver the quality solutions needed to meet project commitments.

- • Updates project management data on reporting and management systems, such as Jira and Salesforce.

- • Manages the relationship with customers and all stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and collaboration.

- • Conducts and manages post-project evaluation to identify successful and unsuccessful project elements.

- • Collaborates with internal stakeholders and the customer to determine the appropriate project methodology. The methodology a customer project manager would typically be required to use include:
o Waterfall (linear-sequential life cycle)
o Agile – SCRUM or Kanban
o A hybrid model combining aspects of the above
o When SCRUM is used, the Client Project Manager would fill the Scrum Master role while also handling other responsibilities beyond the standard Scrum Master definition.

- • Ensures the customer is aligned with the methodology to be used for the project and the budget, scope and planning tracking is aligned prior to the project proceeding via a method adoption workshop.

- • Provides guidance to newer team members.

- • Performs other duties as assigned.

- • Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.

Competencies
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.

- Strong stakeholder management and relationship building

- Advanced problem-solving abilities

You'll join a team of program managers who run the operational programs that keep ClassPass partners, and internal teams moving. As an Associate Program Manager, you'll take on a set of established programs and workstreams delivered through our offshore business process outsourcing (BPO) teams, keep them running well day to day, and support the Senior Program Managers on your team by taking on the operational side of their programs so they can focus on strategy and stakeholder leadership. Manage request intake and prioritization within agreed criteria, set turnaround expectations with stakeholders, and track delivery against SLAs
Write and maintain SOPs, job aids, and training materials so operations teams can execute consistently
Build and maintain program reporting (weekly recaps, monthly readouts, KPI dashboards) and share results with stakeholders and leadership
Investigate root causes behind quality misses, escalations, and rework, and drive fixes with system owners and partner teams
Identify and deliver automation and process improvements that reduce manual effort and operating cost
Support onboarding of partners, clients, or internal teams onto operational programs, including documentation, communication setup, and launch QA
Support Senior Program Managers with operational duties within their programs, including data pulls, reporting, quality reviews, SOP updates, and BPO coordination
Escalate scope, cost, vendor, and prioritization decisions to your manager with a clear recommendation
Contribute to quarterly OKR planning and annual budget inputs for the programs you support
All other duties as assigned

The Experience You’ll Bring

Able to work Mountain Time hours
1 to 2 years of program, project, or operations management experience
1+ year of project and process implementation experience
Experience coordinating with vendors or outsourced teams is a plus
Comfortable working in Salesforce, Excel, Notion, Asana, and Slack; exposure to Tableau or Snowflake is helpful

Project and Program Management

In situ chemical reduction (ISCR)

Soil vapor extraction (SVE)

Vapor intrusion guidance
UST and industrial facility closure programs
California DTSC and Regional Water Board programs

12+ years of environmental consulting experience.
7+ years managing complex remediation projects.
Demonstrated success managing projects exceeding $500K to $5M+ annually.
Significant chlorinated solvent investigation and remediation experience.
California PE, PG, CHG, PMP, REM, CHMM (preferred)

new_jobs.title: VBC Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Compensation:
$105,000 - $120,000

Reports to:
Director of VBC Operations

Direct Reports:
VBC Operations Coordinators and Patient Engagement Representative

Location:
Remote (with the ability for limited travel to facility partners and team meetings)

About Vitae Health Systems:

Founded in 2018, Vitae Health Systems is one of the largest providers of behavioral health, internal medicine, and podiatry services to residents of Skilled Nursing and Assisted Living Facilities. Headquartered in Chicago, IL, we currently operate in over 10 states and are rapidly expanding throughout the USA.

Overview

Vitae launches its ACO under the CMS Long-term Enhanced ACO Design (LEAD) Model on January 1, 2027, building on our experience in ACO REACH High Needs. The VBC Program Manager builds and runs the operating rhythm of the LEAD ACO, making sure the work that drives results (beneficiary alignment, utilization, quality performance, and program compliance) is tracked, scheduled, and followed through on time.

This is a hands-on operating role. You will lead the VBC operations team, run the weekly and monthly performance cadence with the VBC data resource, and work with the VBC clinical team and operations managers to turn performance data into clear, prioritized actions. You own the calendar, the cadence, and the follow-through. Clinical standards and compliance decisions remain with clinical and compliance leadership.

Key Responsibilities

LEAD ACO Operating Cadence and Performance Tracking

Run the weekly team huddle and monthly performance review covering alignment, utilization, quality, and reported spend, using KPIs and targets set by VBC leadership
Track performance against the LEAD quality measures and Prevention and Quality Plan milestones, and report variances to leadership
Monitor utilization drivers (admissions, readmissions, ED visits, post-acute stays) and confirm high-risk patients have a named owner and documented action, escalating gaps to clinical leadership
Review operational CMS reports and data feeds monthly, flag variances early, and escalate risks with a recommended path
Maintain the master calendar of CMS deadlines and deliverables, with a named owner for each, and follow up so nothing is missed

Alignment and Compliance Oversight

Oversee the voluntary alignment program against leadership-set targets and deadlines, including a documented pre-submission review before each CMS submission
Oversee reconciliation of CMS alignment lists to census and EHR data, and lead root cause reviews on avoidable attrition (deaths, hospice elections, moves, Medicare Advantage enrollment)
Reconcile Participant and Preferred Provider lists to HR and credentialing records at the TIN/NPI level, escalating any change that needs a leadership or Compliance decision
Verify that beneficiary notifications and outreach activities are completed, tracked, and documented to CMS requirements, in partnership with Compliance

Cross-Functional Partnership

Work with operations managers on how VBC activities are scheduled and delivered at the facility and NP level, surfacing barriers early and avoiding unnecessary burden
Partner with VBC clinical leadership so workflows, checklists, and handoffs reflect clinical standards
Support development of provider-facing materials (scorecards, tip sheets, trainings) with the clinical and data owners, coordinating timelines and operational input

Data, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Submit and sequence reporting requests to the VBC data resource through a single intake, review data for reasonableness before use in reviews, and flag manual work that could be automated
Prepare the performance summaries the Director of VBC Operations presents to senior leadership and ACO governance, aggregating data, clinical, and operational input
Lead root cause reviews when measures move off target and turn findings into action plans with named owners and due dates, tracking each to closure and routing clinical actions to clinical leadership
Facilitate a quarterly improvement cycle (plan, do, study, act) based on financial and performance results, with the Director of VBC Operations as sponsor: convene Finance, clinical, and data partners to select opportunities, assign actions, evaluate results, and document learning in a VBC operating playbook

Team Leadership

Lead the VBC operations team and serve as its first point of contact: coach, set priorities and escalation thresholds, build SOPs with process owners, and resolve operational questions and blockers within defined boundaries, escalating strategic, financial, compliance, and policy matters to the Director of VBC Operations
Provide input to the Director of VBC Operations on structure and staffing as scope grows

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: The master CMS calendar is in place with named owners. The weekly and monthly cadence is running and escalation thresholds are defined. The first quarterly improvement cycle is launched, with opportunities, owners, measures, and evaluation dates set. Team members have clear goals and documented workflows
First year: Two or more improvement cycles are completed with documented results and feed a VBC operating playbook. Alignment, quality, and utilization are tracked against targets all year, with action plans when a measure is off target. Escalations arrive with context and a recommended path

Requirements

Required

Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, nursing, or a related field
4+ years in value-based care, ACO operations, or population health (provider-side strongly preferred)
Direct experience in a CMS ACO model (ACO REACH, especially High Needs, MSSP, or LEAD)
Experience in post-acute, SNF, or long-term care
2+ years managing staff
Track record running recurring operating cadences and hitting deadlines
Experience running structured improvement cycles (e.g., PDSA, Lean) and building playbooks
Working knowledge of CMS alignment (claims-based and voluntary), ACO quality measures, beneficiary protections and marketing requirements, and benchmark and settlement basics
Ability to drive follow-through across clinical, operational, and data teams without direct authority
Clear communicator who can explain data to clinicians and leaders, and is comfortable with financial and utilization reports, Excel, BI dashboards, and EHR data

Preferred

Understanding of NP-led care teams
Clinical background (e.g., RN)
Master's degree

Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
Short Term & Long Term Disability
Training & Development
Work From Home
Free Food & Snacks
Wellness Resources

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Technical Program Management Team

The Technical Program Management team at Affirm operates at the intersection of strategy, product, and engineering execution. We are versatile operators and trusted strategic partners who drive complex initiatives, design our planning engines, and architect operational frameworks that power the technology behind Affirm's business. Guided by our commitment to putting the customer first and pushing the envelope, we elevate how teams collaborate, resolve critical tradeoffs, and turn high-level vision into scalable reality.

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to oversee high visibility planning programs for our teams and help streamline our processes for building and delivering great customer and merchant products. As our products scale in complexity to meet our accelerating business and expanding product lines, our business and technology process management practices need to scale with it. In this role, you will work closely with engineering, product, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to align efforts with goals, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive change initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Drive complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible transformation & operational programs in service of our team’s mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives
Coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across the company to drive alignment on strategy, priorities, and key decisions.
Implement lean processes and drive towards better ways of working to realize value from planning, ask questions that clarify priorities and push the team to be effective, and build a culture of continuous iteration and improvement
Establish and run data-driven operational frameworks to view portfolio performance against OKRs, accelerate value realization by enabling right investment decisions, influence and train teams on more effective ways of working, and create excitement around change to increase adoption
Develop communication strategies to ensure critical information flows seamlessly across the organization
Partner with cross-functional teams to plan change requirements, identify risks, manage dependencies, and establish tools and forums to drive clarity and efficiency
Identify and distill needs, experiment with new ideas to address systemic inefficiencies and bring transparency, visibility, alignment, and promote accountability across the organization

What We Look For

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
8 years of proven experience managing programs, processes, and change management in a technology-focused environment
Strong technical background with a deep understanding of software development processes
Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams
Obsesses over getting the details right but knows how to make tradeoff decisions
Strong stakeholder management with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams
Track record of successfully implementing frameworks at scale and building relationships in a remote friendly culture
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and consulting skills
Passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better
Prior experience in FinTech, Payments or Commerce is a plus.

The Senior Program Manager, Plasmid DNA
is responsible for leading Aldevron's most strategic and complex plasmid DNA programs, with a primary focus on marketed products, commercial supply, and late-phase clinical programs progressing through process validation, Process Performance Qualification (PPQ), regulatory readiness, and commercial launch.

This role serves as the senior client-facing program leader for assigned programs and integrates commercial agreements with technical and operational execution. The Program Manager ensures alignment across scope, schedule, quality, supply continuity, financial performance, regulatory expectations, and customer commitments throughout validation, PPQ, launch preparation, recurring commercial supply, and lifecycle management.

The Program Manager partners closely with Business Development, Legal, Contracts, Project Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Technical Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership to convert contractual commitments into executable plans, resolve complex issues, protect Aldevron's business interests, and build durable strategic client partnerships.

This position reports to the Vice President, North America Sales and is part of the Program Management Organization located in Fargo, ND and will be fully remote.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Lead Program and Project Execution: Lead highly complex, multi-program portfolios across strategic accounts, owning end-to-end delivery across multiple concurrent projects with significant revenue, risk, and cross-functional dependencies, ensuring alignment with timelines, budgets, and KPIs.
Cultivate Strategic Client Relationships: Own and influence senior-level client relationships and account strategy, acting as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, navigating escalations, and shaping program direction and long-term partnership outcomes.
Internal Team Alignment and Development: Drive enterprise-wide alignment and decision-making, leading cross-functional teams through ambiguity, resolving competing priorities, and influencing outcomes across functions and leadership levels.
Ensure Operational Excellence and Governance: Establish and maintain program governance structures, track project metrics, forecast capacity, and provide regular updates to senior leadership on project status, risks, and opportunities. Translate master service agreements, statements of work, supply and quality agreements, amendments, and change orders into executable operating requirements, and partner with Business Development, Legal, Contracts, and Finance to assess feasibility, manage scope change, support negotiations, and protect Aldevron's commercial and contractual position.

B.S. or B.A. required. Advanced degree in scientific field strongly preferred (e.g. molecular biology, biology, biotechnology, biochemistry)

Experience managing programs and contracts in a regulated biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or medical device related field required
Working knowledge of plasmid DNA manufacturing and its use in cell and gene therapy, gene editing, mRNA, vaccines, or other genomic medicine applications; strong preference for late phase/commercial drug product experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to forecast risks and implement sustainable solutions.

An advanced degree in a scientific, engineering, legal, project management, or business discipline, or a program or project management certification such as PMP.
Direct program leadership for commercial or late-phase plasmid DNA programs through process characterization, technology transfer, process validation, PPQ campaigns, regulatory inspections, commercial launch, recurring supply, or post-approval lifecycle management.
Experience managing strategic accounts, cross-site programs, long-term supply agreements, capacity reservation models, demand planning, forecast commitments, pricing protections, change-order mechanisms, termination provisions, executive governance, or commercial supply continuity.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Risk Ops Enablement
new_jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Risk Operations Enablement team sits within the Risk Operations org and is responsible for building and operating the core business and strategic programs that are critical to Risk Operations. These programs range from operational excellence initiatives to high-priority, cross-functional initiatives that typically require partnering across broader Risk (e.g., Risk Product) and risk-adjacent (e.g., Policy) teams. More specifically, we both lead initiatives to make step changes in the Risk User Experience and devise and execute strategies to ensure that a wide range of missing-critical business processes are effective at achieving our dual goals of preventing bad actors from exploiting our systems and delivering an exceptional user experience for legitimate users.

What you'll do

You'll partner cross-functionally across Risk (e.g., Risk Product) and Risk-adjacent (e.g., Policy) teams to lead ambiguous, high-priority problem spaces that change the trajectory of Risk Operations. You'll also partner across Risk Operations to deliver and measure processes that enable operational excellence at scale within the Risk Operations org.

Responsibilities

Lead complex global programs, from initial scoping to design and execution and work on high-impact strategic initiatives
Collaborate with multiple stakeholders across Risk Operations, Risk Product, Risk Eng, and other stakeholder teams (e.g., Policy, Data Science) to prioritize and maximize the impact of your projects
Design and launch programs that lead to step-change improvements in our operational processes and business outcomes
Serve as the Risk Operations expert and partner closely with our cross-functional stakeholders to scope and execute large projects to create operational efficiencies and ensure operational readiness
Embody our Operating Principles and foster our values and culture

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

6+ years of experience in risk program management, strategy, management consulting, business operations, or operations program management
The ability to dig deep into the data and think from first principles while delivering the best results
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders with varying priorities and drive creative solutions and commitment to a shared goal
Strong program management skills with experience managing end-to-end execution of projects and programs that have transformed your company's operations
Enjoys solving complex and hard problems and can turn incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs into solid action plans and deliver quantifiable business impact
Ability to identify repeated user and specialist-facing issues and build scalable solutions and processes to address them

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years in consulting
Experience with SQL or willingness to learn
MBA or other graduate degree
Prior experience partnering with Product, Eng, and Operations teams preferred

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Location: Fully remote
Eligibility Requirements: Due to the nature of the work, the successful candidate must be UK-based and eligible for DV clearance.

About the role

TwinStream is seeking a Delivery Manager who can operate confidently across both project and programme-level delivery. This role blends agile, flow-based delivery practices with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, align stakeholders, manage complex risks, and maintain visibility across broader initiatives.
You’ll work closely with Technical Leads, engineers, and senior stakeholders to ensure that software delivery is predictable, well-governed (lightly), and aligned to programme objectives. This role is ideal for someone who can zoom out to see the bigger picture while still helping teams maintain a healthy delivery flow.

Responsibilities

Programme-Level Coordination & Planning

Coordinate delivery across multiple related projects or workstreams to ensure alignment with programme goals.
Maintain a clear, high-level view of progress, risks, dependencies, and resource needs across the programme.
Support roadmap shaping and programme-level planning with Technical Leads and product/strategy stakeholders.
Facilitate alignment discussions across teams to clarify priorities, architectural considerations, and sequencing decisions.

Agile Delivery Management

Lead delivery activities using Kanban and flow-based agile practices across one or more teams.
Maintain visibility of work-in-progress, blockers, throughput, and upcoming priorities.
Support teams in balancing feature delivery, technical debt, architectural improvements, and research/activity spikes.
Encourage continuous flow, reducing bottlenecks and ensuring smooth transitions between stages of delivery.

Lightweight Governance & Reporting

Provide structured but concise reporting suitable for programme sponsors and senior leadership.
Track progress against objectives, milestones, and commitments across multiple workstreams.
Capture key decisions, risks, issues, and actions in a lightweight but traceable way.
Help define and mature TwinStream’s delivery governance model — ensuring it remains agile and value-driven.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

Identify and manage programme-level risks, ensuring they are surfaced early and escalated appropriately.
Coordinate cross-team and cross-vendor dependencies with clarity and urgency.
Use a pragmatic, simple RAID process to maintain visibility and drive mitigation actions.
Support teams in resolving blockers that span across technical or organisational boundaries.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

Act as the central coordination point for engineering, Technical Leads, internal stakeholders, and (when relevant) customers.
Communicate delivery updates with clarity, tailored to the audience — technical or non-technical.
Align expectations around timelines, scope, assumptions, and emerging risks.
Support commercial teams during pre-sales, estimation, and contract/change discussions as needed.

Continuous Improvement & Ways of Working

Contribute to improving TwinStream’s delivery framework, tools, and documentation.
Help establish scalable delivery patterns as TwinStream takes on more complex and multi-stream programmes.
Promote transparency, psychological safety, and a culture of proactive delivery.

Key Skills

Experience managing software delivery across multiple teams or workstreams, not just single-project coordination.
Strong understanding of flow-based agile delivery and programme-level planning.
Proven ability to identify cross-cutting risks, large dependencies, and structural blockers.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at all levels of the organisation.
Confidence operating in environments that value structure but avoid heavy process.
A pragmatic, solution-focused mindset and the ability to bring clarity in uncertainty
