new_jobs.description:
Project Manager

Mission Critical Data Center Programs (HVAC)

$140,000-$190,000 + Performance Bonus + 401K

Location:
Remote, United States

About Our Client

Zest Technical is partnering exclusively with a North American leader in the sustainable design and advanced manufacturing of custom air handling and liquid cooling systems. With decades of HVAC engineering and manufacturing expertise, they deliver energy-efficient solutions for mission-critical industries including hyperscale and modular data centers, healthcare, life sciences, semiconductors and advanced manufacturing.

The Opportunity

Our client is expanding its Service organisation to support some of the world’s largest hyperscale data center projects. They are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead onsite execution of complex HVAC service and construction programs.
You will be the on-site face of the business for customers, General Contractors (GCs) and mechanical and electrical trade partners. You will own execution across both air-side equipment (CRAC/CRAH units, air handling units, economizers) and chiller/water-side plant (chillers, cooling towers, pumps, piping). Your remit runs from rework and start-up through commissioning, warranty and field support, including BMS and controls integration, in uptime-critical Tier III/IV environments.

Key Responsibilities

Apply project methodologies to drive scalable, repeatable and cost-effective execution across mission-critical HVAC programs
Lead internal and external teams (mechanical contractors, controls integrators, GCs, commissioning agents) across rework, start-up, commissioning, warranty and field support
Lead execution across both air-side and chiller/water-side systems
Coordinate Level 3-5 commissioning, including equipment start-up, functional performance testing and integrated systems testing (IST)
Coordinate OEM technicians and commissioning agents to validate cooling capacity and redundancy design
Track progress, risks and interdependencies across equipment delivery, refrigerant piping, ductwork and controls sequencing against construction schedules
Ensure strict adherence to safety requirements including LOTO, confined space and hot work, particularly in live or near-live data halls
Act as primary escalation point and strategic liaison with GCs, mechanical engineers and data center operators on scope, schedule and change management
Oversee Superintendents and other onsite staff
Represent the business at all GC and project meetings, with regular construction-site presence

About You

7+ years of progressive experience in HVAC service operations or project management, ideally within mission-critical or data center environments
Proven track record managing complex HVAC mechanical programs across both:
Air-side systems: CRAC/CRAH units, air handlers, precision cooling and VRF
Chiller/water-side systems: chillers, cooling towers, condenser water and chilled water piping
Direct experience in data centers, hyperscale, colocation or other uptime-sensitive facilities strongly preferred
Working knowledge of mechanical drawings and sequences of operation
Working knowledge of BMS/controls platforms and protocols such as BACnet, Niagara and Modbus
Experience with ERP/CRM systems, service management platforms and performance dashboards
Mechanical or HVAC engineering background preferred; strong operational, business or technical program management experience within HVAC will also be considered
Strong planning and follow-through, clear communication at all levels, a customer-first mindset, and composure under tight, shifting priorities

What’s on Offer

Salary of $140,000-$190,000 depending on experience, plus performance bonus
Medical, dental and vision insurance
401(k)
Employee assistance program
Paid time off
A fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment supporting the AI infrastructure boom
Genuine career progression, with a culture that promotes from within
An inclusive, diversity-friendly workplace

Preferred qualifications:

Experience with Lean, Six Sigma or similar methods to streamline workflows, cut cycle times and improve how well vulnerability remediation programs scale.
Familiarity with data center critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical and cooling controls, and how cybersecurity risk turns into operational and uptime risk.

About The Job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Program Manager for Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity, you will support vulnerability management programs across the operational technology that supports critical infrastructure. These environments have tight downtime limits, safety concerns and complex vendor dependencies, so standard IT remediation practices often don't apply. You will manage vulnerability projects including end-to-end remediation, metrics development, and exceptions reporting. You will also drive the initial triage of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), judging exploitability in an OT context, checking applicability against the asset inventory, and coordinate with the OT Security Review Working Group to deliberate on a severity as needed. You will also build the program structure that makes this repeatable at scale, including tracking in Task Flow, SOPs and swimlanes. The role calls for strong ICS technical knowledge, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn technical risk into prioritized plans that protect both security and uptime.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Read and interpret CVEs and ICS advisories from sources such as CISA ICS-CERT, vendor PSIRTs and Mandiant threat intelligence. Turn the technical findings into clear, actionable guidance for operational teams.
Judge real-world exploitability in an OT context by looking at network exposure, the access an attacker would need, and device mode or state. Check advisories against the OT asset inventory to find affected devices, models and firmware versions, so remediation targets the right assets.
Plan, track and report on cross-functional remediation programs in a project management tool such as Task Flow.
Keep milestones, dependencies, blockers and SLO performance visible. Write and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Run triage decisions on critical vulnerabilities and send qualified findings to the right engineering, operations or vendor teams.

About The Job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Program Manager for Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity, you will support vulnerability management programs across the operational technology that supports critical infrastructure. These environments have tight downtime limits, safety concerns and complex vendor dependencies, so standard IT remediation practices often don't apply. You will manage vulnerability projects including end-to-end remediation, metrics development, and exceptions reporting. You will also drive the initial triage of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), judging exploitability in an OT context, checking applicability against the asset inventory, and coordinate with the OT Security Review Working Group to deliberate on a severity as needed. You will also build the program structure that makes this repeatable at scale, including tracking in Task Flow, SOPs and swimlanes. The role calls for strong ICS technical knowledge, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn technical risk into prioritized plans that protect both security and uptime.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Read and interpret CVEs and ICS advisories from sources such as CISA ICS-CERT, vendor PSIRTs and Mandiant threat intelligence. Turn the technical findings into clear, actionable guidance for operational teams.
Judge real-world exploitability in an OT context by looking at network exposure, the access an attacker would need, and device mode or state. Check advisories against the OT asset inventory to find affected devices, models and firmware versions, so remediation targets the right assets.
Plan, track and report on cross-functional remediation programs in a project management tool such as Task Flow.

Run triage decisions on critical vulnerabilities and send qualified findings to the right engineering, operations or vendor teams.

Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:
Austin,TX; Washington, D.C.

Security at Cloudflare is a diverse, focused team committed to helping secure both Cloudflare and our customers. The Security Technical Program Management team sits at the intersection of engineering, security, and business. We define, align, and drive the strategic security programs that reduce risk and advance innovation across Cloudflare, while partnering to build the best solutions for our customers.

About The Role

Cloudflare is seeking a highly skilled, self-motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the company’s strategic Governance, Risk, and Compliance program, initially focused on the Department of Defense Impact Level 4 (IL4) initiative.

As a Technical Program Manager focused on Governance, Risk, and Compliance, you will define, align, and drive complex security and compliance programs that reduce risk and enable Cloudflare’s regulated business. You will manage stakeholder expectations, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and ensure the delivery of predictable, high-impact outcomes.

The ideal candidate is process-oriented yet remains flexible and iterative. You excel at navigating ambiguous technical challenges, fostering collaboration across teams, and asking the insightful questions necessary to drive stakeholders toward measurable results. This position requires a professional capable of managing complex tradeoffs and coordinating teams across global time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance team as its dedicated Technical Program Manager
Lead the integrated IL4 roadmap, milestones, dependencies, and execution cadence
Connect with stakeholders through expert communication and diplomacy to maintain alignment and encourage collaboration
Establish and maintain a program operating cadence: roadmap, governance forums, decision log, risk/issue register, communications plan, and executive reporting
Build automations and AI agents to handle routine program administration at scale
Utilize AI platforms to consolidate diverse project streams into unified roadmaps, generating initial metrics, status updates, and executive reporting dashboards
Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities by identifying tradeoffs early, applying risk-based judgment, and balancing long-term compliance objectives with urgent security needs

Desirable Skills And Knowledge

8+ years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of continuous improvement
Experience in cybersecurity or security program management in a technical, fast-moving environment
BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security or related field or equivalent experience
Proven track record of creating realistic project plans, managing dependencies, and overseeing execution to meet commitments with predictability
Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and authorization frameworks (for example, NIST SP 800-53, RMF, FedRAMP, and DoD SRGs), with the ability to translate requirements into program plans and measurable delivery
Proven ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including executives
Hands-on experience or a strong competency in leveraging AI productivity tools and development platforms to automate routine program administration, with rigorous human-in-the-loop review of AI output
Comfortable managing tight deadlines, changing priorities, and ambiguity
Proven ability to forge and sustain effective partnerships internally and externally
Strong competency with Confluence and Jira and various development methodologies

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Technical Solutions
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated and experienced Technical Program Manager to join Datadog’s Technical Solutions organization. This organization is made up of 1,200+ customer-facing technical experts around the world — including Sales Engineers, Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, and Solution Architects — who work with prospects and customers throughout their journey with Datadog to deliver outstanding experiences and drive growth through product adoption.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will lead and support a variety of technical programs that help these customer-facing teams work more effectively. Depending on the needs of the organization, this could include programs related to internal tooling, process improvement, knowledge and content systems, or other cross-functional initiatives. You’ll partner closely with team leads, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders to bring structure and clarity to moderately complex, cross-team programs, and you’ll act as a multiplier for the teams you support by driving programs from planning through delivery. Candidates who have previously led projects for customer-facing technical teams are especially encouraged to apply.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do

Drive delivery of cross-team programs that support one or more Technical Solutions teams — coordinating stakeholders, dependencies, and timelines to keep work on track from kickoff through delivery.
Partner with team leads, subject matter experts, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate program goals into clear, actionable plans, and document scope, timeline, and quality expectations along the way.
Establish and maintain program management fundamentals — project trackers, status updates, risk logs — so stakeholders always have visibility into progress and blockers.
Identify unclear or incomplete requirements early and bring structure to ambiguous problems, escalating only when needed to keep execution on track.
Use data to track progress against milestones, surface risks, and guide decisions; adjust plans as circumstances change.
Apply AI tools to streamline your own program management workflows — synthesizing updates, surfacing patterns in program data, or accelerating documentation — and help identify where AI can improve processes for the teams you support.
Communicate program status, risks, and impact clearly to stakeholders at different levels, adapting your message for technical and non-technical audiences.
Look for opportunities to improve how programs and processes run, and contribute ideas that make execution more efficient over time.

Who You Are

Program Management Experience: 3-5 years of experience leading technical programs in a SaaS or technical environment, ideally including cross-team or cross-functional initiatives. Experience supporting customer-facing or technical support functions is a plus.
Execution-Oriented: Comfortable driving moderately complex, cross-team initiatives independently, with the judgment to seek guidance on larger or more ambiguous efforts. Solid foundation in project scoping, timeline management, and risk management; PMP, Agile training, or equivalent certification preferred.
Data-Informed: Tracks progress against established metrics and uses data to guide decisions, report status, and identify risks early.
Clear Communicator: Able to convey project status and ideas concisely to a range of audiences, from peers to senior stakeholders, adapting the level of detail as needed.
Collaborative: Builds trust through consistent delivery; works constructively across teams to resolve differing viewpoints and unblock progress.
Comfortable with Ambiguity: Able to identify unclear requirements, ask the right questions, and bring structure to partially-defined problems.
AI Fluency: Uses AI tools confidently in day-to-day program work and can evaluate where AI can be responsibly and effectively applied to improve program processes.
Growth-Oriented: Developing skill in giving constructive, empathetic feedback; may support the onboarding or mentorship of newer team members.
Technical Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent industry experience.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits And Growth

Generous and competitive benefits package
New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
Continuous career development and pathing opportunities
Best in breed onboarding
Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is:

$116,000—$148,000 USD

About Datadog:

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Equal Opportunity at Datadog:

Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference.

Datadog endeavors to make our Careers Page accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please complete this form. This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Privacy and AI Guidelines:

Any information you submit to Datadog as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Datadog’s Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice. For information on our AI policy, please visit Interviewing at Datadog AI Guidelines.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Data Platform
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

Job Overview

Senior Project Manager, Data Platform

About the role

We’re looking for a strong, assertive Project Manager to support a consumer data platform program built on a modern cloud lakehouse and AWS. This role will drive delivery of the consumer data foundation, including a canonical data model, consumer data warehouse, governed metrics, and shared data assets used by analytics, data science, risk, and finance teams.

You will own day-to-day execution across multiple workstreams, keep teams moving at pace, and ensure priorities are clear, dependencies are managed, and decisions are made quickly. You will work directly with product management, data engineering, data architecture, analytics, and business stakeholders to remove blockers and maintain momentum.

This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who is comfortable operating with urgency, challenging assumptions, and pushing teams toward timely decisions and accountable execution. You should be able to speak credibly with technical teams on data platform concepts and AWS, while also holding business stakeholders accountable for clarity, prioritization, and responsiveness.

What you’ll do in your first 12 months

Drive execution of the consumer data platform roadmap with a strong bias for speed, clarity, and outcome-based delivery.
Keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel by actively managing milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and releases.
Coordinate across product, engineering, architecture, analytics, risk, and finance teams to ensure delivery stays on track.
Track delivery of critical platform initiatives such as canonical data modeling, data warehouse buildout, metric standardization, and data quality improvements.
Push for rapid resolution of blockers, open questions, and cross-team dependencies before they impact timelines.
Maintain tight control over project plans, RAID logs, status updates, and stakeholder communications.
Challenge engineering estimates and delivery schedules where assumptions are weak, scope is unclear, or dependencies are not fully accounted for.
Push back on business stakeholders when requirements are incomplete, ambiguous, or not actionable, and insist on the clarity needed to move execution forward.
Ensure decisions are documented, actions are assigned, and follow-through happens quickly.
Work with technical teams to understand AWS-based data platform components such as storage, compute, orchestration, pipelines, and access patterns.
Help ensure solutions are tested, documented, and ready for adoption by downstream teams.
Escalate risks early and decisively when timelines, quality, or scope are at risk.

Required qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience working on data platforms, data warehouses, lakehouse environments, or enterprise data programs.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience with Lean, Six Sigma or similar methods to streamline workflows, cut cycle times and improve how well vulnerability remediation programs scale.
Familiarity with data center critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical and cooling controls, and how cybersecurity risk turns into operational and uptime risk.

About The Job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Program Manager for Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity, you will support vulnerability management programs across the operational technology that supports critical infrastructure. These environments have tight downtime limits, safety concerns and complex vendor dependencies, so standard IT remediation practices often don't apply. You will manage vulnerability projects including end-to-end remediation, metrics development, and exceptions reporting. You will also drive the initial triage of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), judging exploitability in an OT context, checking applicability against the asset inventory, and coordinate with the OT Security Review Working Group to deliberate on a severity as needed. You will also build the program structure that makes this repeatable at scale, including tracking in Task Flow, SOPs and swimlanes. The role calls for strong ICS technical knowledge, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn technical risk into prioritized plans that protect both security and uptime.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Read and interpret CVEs and ICS advisories from sources such as CISA ICS-CERT, vendor PSIRTs and Mandiant threat intelligence. Turn the technical findings into clear, actionable guidance for operational teams.
Judge real-world exploitability in an OT context by looking at network exposure, the access an attacker would need, and device mode or state. Check advisories against the OT asset inventory to find affected devices, models and firmware versions, so remediation targets the right assets.
Plan, track and report on cross-functional remediation programs in a project management tool such as Task Flow.
Keep milestones, dependencies, blockers and SLO performance visible. Write and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Run triage decisions on critical vulnerabilities and send qualified findings to the right engineering, operations or vendor teams.

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Technical Program Management Team

The Technical Program Management team at Affirm operates at the intersection of strategy, product, and engineering execution. We are versatile operators and trusted strategic partners who drive complex initiatives, design our planning engines, and architect operational frameworks that power the technology behind Affirm's business. Guided by our commitment to putting the customer first and pushing the envelope, we elevate how teams collaborate, resolve critical tradeoffs, and turn high-level vision into scalable reality.

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to oversee high visibility planning programs for our teams and help streamline our processes for building and delivering great customer and merchant products. As our products scale in complexity to meet our accelerating business and expanding product lines, our business and technology process management practices need to scale with it. In this role, you will work closely with engineering, product, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to align efforts with goals, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive change initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Drive complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible transformation & operational programs in service of our team’s mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives
Coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across the company to drive alignment on strategy, priorities, and key decisions.
Implement lean processes and drive towards better ways of working to realize value from planning, ask questions that clarify priorities and push the team to be effective, and build a culture of continuous iteration and improvement
Establish and run data-driven operational frameworks to view portfolio performance against OKRs, accelerate value realization by enabling right investment decisions, influence and train teams on more effective ways of working, and create excitement around change to increase adoption
Develop communication strategies to ensure critical information flows seamlessly across the organization
Partner with cross-functional teams to plan change requirements, identify risks, manage dependencies, and establish tools and forums to drive clarity and efficiency
Identify and distill needs, experiment with new ideas to address systemic inefficiencies and bring transparency, visibility, alignment, and promote accountability across the organization

What We Look For

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
8 years of proven experience managing programs, processes, and change management in a technology-focused environment
Strong technical background with a deep understanding of software development processes
Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams
Obsesses over getting the details right but knows how to make tradeoff decisions
Strong stakeholder management with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams
Track record of successfully implementing frameworks at scale and building relationships in a remote friendly culture
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and consulting skills
Passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better
Prior experience in FinTech, Payments or Commerce is a plus.

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

new_jobs.description:
At Instabee, we’re bringing together three of the Nordics' most loved delivery brands—Instabox, Porterbuddy, and Budbee—to build the future of European e-commerce delivery. Sweden is our innovation hub: the home market where we test bold ideas, build scalable models, and set the standard for the rest of Europe.

We are growing fast, and with scale comes complexity. We’re looking for a curious, collaborative, and analytical Market Intelligence Manager to step in, own our market knowledge, and help shape our strategic growth. Beyond your technical expertise, we are looking for someone with the ambition and potential to develop alongside Instabee and take on broader responsibilities over time.

The Role

As our Market Intelligence Manager at Instabee, you will be the owner of our market knowledge across all our markets: Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands and Belgium.

You will play a vital role in tracking the rapid developments of the e-commerce landscape, ensuring our commercial teams have a clear view of our performance across both current and potential customers. This includes identifying new targets, building pipeline, tracking existing portfolios, and reporting key business metrics such as market share and category growth.

This position is perfect for someone who loves to combine "detective work" with technical execution. You will have a unique opportunity to own our commercial data, build and maintain market models, and experiment with AI agents to automate our intelligence gathering. You will gain firsthand experience in a fast-paced, tech-based scale-up where your insights directly impact our growth trajectory.

Key Responsibilities

Landscape & Competitor Intelligence: Map the evolving e-commerce ecosystem, analyze market share, perform win/loss analyses, and keep our teams informed on regional and competitor strategies (products, pricing, positioning, and financial moves).
Market Modeling & Data Ownership: Build, refine, and maintain market models and commercial data to serve as the foundation for commercial decision making. Set up automated data collection flows using AI for e.g. web scraping, desktop research, and external sources.
Strategic Partnership & Workshops: Act as a trusted partner to sales leaders and key stakeholders. Translate complex data into actionable sales leads, deliver clear insights, and facilitate interactive team workshops.
Technical Bridge & Systems: Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) to our Data Platform and Sales tech teams to ensure connections to our Salesforce, and Snowflake setups.
Visualization & Dashboards: Design and maintain intuitive dashboards and present insights for senior stakeholders to make intelligence accessible across the business.

What We Are Looking For

Skills

We value diverse backgrounds and fresh perspectives. While no candidate will check every single box, we are looking for someone who brings a strong combination of the following skills and qualities:

Background: A couple of years of experience in management consulting, scale-ups/startups, or an analytical commercial role.
Analytical Skills: Advanced capability in Excel/Google Sheets with an ability to identify clear signals within complex datasets.
Technical Toolbox: Experience with (or a strong desire to learn) SQL and Salesforce.
Curiosity for Innovation: Genuine interest in using AI tools and automation to optimize workflows and scale intelligence.
Project Leadership: Proven ability to take initiatives from early-stage ideas through to completed deliverables and implemented systems.
Mindset & Style: Adaptable, resourceful, and supportive. You are a strong communicator, a helpful teammate, and someone who thrives in a fast-changing environment.
Education & Languages: University degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field. Fluency in English is required; Swedish is a strong bonus.

Life at Instabee & What We Offer

We believe that high performance thrives in a supportive, flexible, and fun environment. Joining Instabee means joining a close-knit team that values every individual’s perspective.

Highlights Of Working With Us

🏢 Brand-New Office
: More Space for Our Brilliant People. Soon moving into our new Stockholm HQ, designed to bring our people together to collaborate, connect, create and deliver.

🏓 Fun & Games:
Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and a private Karaoke Room.

👶 Parental Top-Up:
6 months of parental pay support so you can focus on your family.

🎂 Birthday Off:
Enjoy your special day on us with an extra day off every year.

⏰ Flexible Hybrid Setup:
Working hours designed to adapt to your life.

Diversity & Inclusion

Instabee is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome applicants of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences.

Ready to build the future of e-commerce with us? Apply today — we look forward to meeting you!

Good to know

We believe in fair, objective, and inclusive recruitment. To look beyond just a CV and better understand your potential, our process includes a short, science-backed assessment via Alva Labs.

As trust and safety are key to our culture and business, we also carry out a standard background check through Svensk Bakgrundsanalys before final offers are made. Everything is treated with strict confidentiality, and we are happy to answer any questions along the way.

Formed in 2022 through the merger of Budbee and Instabox (uniting the Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy brands), Instabee provides seamless e-commerce deliveries to millions of consumers. We are growing quickly across the Nordics and continental Europe, building cutting-edge logistics technology that handles millions of parcels each week.

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

As a Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst on Target’s Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) team, you will support the identification, collection, analysis, production, and dissemination of intelligence on cyber threat activity that may pose a risk to Target. This role contributes to strategic, operational, and tactical intelligence objectives by converting threat reporting, technical indicators, behavioral observations, and internal security context into insights that inform detection, response, and risk prioritization.

You will work closely with fellow CTI analysts and cross-functional security partners to understand and communicate cyber threat activity relevant to Target. A successful candidate will demonstrate analytic rigor, technical curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently while collaborating across teams to strengthen analytic tradecraft and advance CTI capabilities.

Use your skills, experience, and talents to be a part of groundbreaking thinking and visionary goals. As a Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst, you will:

Serve as an all-source cyber threat intelligence analyst supporting operational and tactical CTI priorities through the collection, evaluation, cataloging, and analysis of threat information from internal telemetry, external reporting, open-source research, vendor sources, peer communities, and security investigations.

Analyze indicators of compromise, threat actor TTPs, intrusion patterns, malware behaviors, infrastructure, vulnerabilities, and campaign activity to generate actionable intelligence for Target.
Develop and maintain subject-matter expertise on cybercriminal groups, emerging threats, technology platforms, and threat vectors relevant to Target’s operating environment.
Partner with CSIRT, Reverse Engineering, Threat Management, Vulnerability Management, and other security teams to contextualize threats, support investigations, and refine detection and response efforts.
Collaborate with Security Ninjas and other teams across the broader security organization to incorporate threat intelligence into threat modeling and other security initiatives, providing adversary context, TTPs, and emerging threat insights to inform risk identification and mitigation.
Draft, edit, and deliver finished intelligence products and briefings, including threat assessments, actor profiles, incident support reporting, and recurring intelligence updates.

Identify opportunities to improve CTI processes, tools, collection requirements, analytic workflows, and dissemination methods; partner with Threat Intelligence Engineering and cross-functional teams to automate and streamline workflows.
Coordinate with trusted external peer groups, industry communities, and information-sharing partners to exchange intelligence, maintain awareness of the broader cyber threat landscape, and influence outcomes that advance CTI priorities.

Experience producing intelligence products and briefings for incident response, detection engineering, security operations, leadership, or business stakeholders, with strong verbal, written, and presentation skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant language.
Demonstrated ability to collect, analyze, synthesize, and interpret qualitative and quantitative data from multiple sources; develop threat expertise; identify complex actor behavior patterns; and produce actionable judgments with appropriate analytic confidence.
Experience applying analytic frameworks and methodologies such as the intelligence cycle, Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain, MITRE ATT&CK, and structured analytic techniques.
Experience using digital investigation and intelligence tools such as VirusTotal, VMRay, DomainTools, URLScan, Maltego, Analyst Notebook, or comparable platforms, along with strong online research skills across technical, open-source, social media, forum, and traditional sources.
Solid problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and ability to operate effectively in a fast.

new_jobs.title: Strategic Threats Program Manager Senior Associate
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Protecting a global financial institution requires more than technology — it demands sharp minds who understand the complex landscape of nation state threats. At JPMorganChase, our Global Security team is at the forefront of identifying, assessing, and mitigating strategic risks that could impact our people, data, and operations worldwide. This is your opportunity to bring your national security expertise to one of the world's most influential financial institutions and make a measurable difference every day.

As a Senior Associate
at JPMorganChase within the Global Security Strategic Threats program, you will serve as a key contributor on a high-performing team dedicated to identifying and countering nation state threats to the firm. Based in Washington, D.C., you will partner across lines of business and corporate functions — including cybersecurity, legal, and compliance to deliver intelligence-driven risk assessments and mitigation strategies. Your work will directly inform senior leadership decisions and help safeguard the firm's critical information, workforce, and supply chain. This role offers exceptional visibility and the opportunity to collaborate with some of the most motivated professionals in the national security field.

The Strategic Threats program operates at the intersection of counterintelligence, business risk, and corporate security, providing dedicated support to all areas of the firm. You will engage directly with business stakeholders to understand their operations, vet external relationships, and equip teams with actionable security guidance. This is not a cybersecurity role it is a national security role that requires deep analytical expertise, creative problem-solving, and the ability to communicate complex threat information to diverse audiences.

Job Responsibilities

Establish and maintain collaborative partnerships with Global Security, Cybersecurity and Technology Controls, and other internal stakeholders to identify and mitigate nation state-related threats to the firm
Provide dedicated counterintelligence support across all lines of business and corporate functions, engaging directly with business stakeholders to understand operations and assess risk exposure
Produce high-quality analytic risk assessments on nation state threats, insider threats, and supply chain vulnerabilities to inform fully informed business decisions
Conduct research and analysis in support of nation state-related investigations, leveraging multiple databases and designated intelligence tools
Develop and deliver education and awareness materials on strategic threats, tailored to a variety of internal audiences
Identify nation state targeting of employees and supply chain partners, and recommend mitigation strategies to protect the firm's critical information
Communicate complex strategic threat issues clearly and compellingly to senior leadership through structured briefings and presentations

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile
 brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

Job Description

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist
to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.

Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.*

Your daily adventure:

Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.
Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.
Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from.
Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization.
Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio.
Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices.
Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization.
Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.
Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights.
Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI/GenAI trends.
Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team.

Qualifications

YOUR SKILLS

Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.
3+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry.
Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis.
Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.
Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).
Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.
Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.
Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.
Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.
Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.

Nice to Have:

Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.
Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences).
Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).
Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.
Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.
Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.

Additional Information

YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)

Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery free of taxes).
Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.

Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.

Professional development training & programs, based upon request.
Ubisoft games are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
Locally roasted craft coffee by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).

new_jobs.description:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

About The Role

GEICO Commercial is seeking a Senior Business Strategy Analyst
to help shape the future of our growing commercial insurance business. This is a highly visible opportunity for an experienced insurance professional who is passionate about driving strategy, influencing key business decisions, and delivering measurable results.

In this role, you will go beyond traditional business analysis by identifying growth opportunities, developing strategic recommendations, and collaborating across the organization to bring ideas to life. You will work closely with leaders across distribution, product, technology, operations, finance, and analytics to improve how commercial insurance products are distributed and serviced.

If you have experience in property and casualty insurance, commercial insurance, product management, distribution strategy, or related business functions
, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact while helping define the future of GEICO Commercial.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct market, competitive, customer, and operational research to identify trends and business opportunities.
Translate research findings into actionable recommendations that support strategic decision-making.
Assess the effectiveness and financial impact of distribution strategies, identifying opportunities to improve: Growth Profitability Customer experience Operational efficiency
Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives from concept through implementation.
Partner with teams across distribution, product, technology, operations, finance, and analytics to drive business outcomes.
Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, business risks, and growth opportunities.
Serve as a business owner for key distribution platforms and enhancement backlogs by: Defining business requirements Prioritizing initiatives Partnering with technical teams on implementation
Develop executive-level presentations, business cases, and strategic recommendations for senior leadership.
Communicate insights, tradeoffs, and proposed solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Insurance, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to simplify complex business, financial, and technical concepts.
Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to move initiatives from strategy through execution.
Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving capabilities using data, metrics, and business insights to support decision-making.
Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams to deliver projects or programs from concept through implementation.
Ability to develop executive-ready materials, including: Business cases Strategy recommendations Executive presentations Leadership communications

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: Property & Casualty Insurance Commercial Insurance Insurance Distribution Product Management Business Strategy Management Consulting
Experience evaluating: Distribution performance Operating models Customer experience strategies Digital platforms Growth initiatives within the insurance industry
Experience supporting financial performance, profitability initiatives, P&L management, or business case development.
Understanding of: Auto Insurance Commercial Auto Insurance Small Business Insurance Underwriting Agency Distribution Models Related Insurance Operations

Annual Salary

$77,900.00 - $129,150.00

The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

At this time, GEICO will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

Protecting customers through life’s twists and turns with innovation and integrity.

Inclusive and collaborative culture rooted in shared success.

Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well-being and future.

new_jobs.description:
Mechanics Bank is currently searching for a Information Security Analyst to join our team. Here at Mechanics Bank, we value connection, partnership, long term relationships and working together in person. This role is based on-site in California.

Under direct supervision, Provides direction to Mechanics Banks Support team in support of the Bank’s guidelines for the establishment and modification of employee access to authorized systems. Responsible for being the eyes and ears and first level escalation for all security events generated by the banks security systems. In addition, responsible for assisting in maintaining, enhancing and automating security alerting applications.

What you will do:

Works with other departments to ensure compliance of company policies.
Assist security engineering when required with all security related projects.
Takes a lead role in conducting security research on threats and remediation techniques and technology. Makes recommendations to Information Security and Information Technology teams and oversees implementation. Able to fine tune and streamline all security alerting.
Tier 1 for all security event analysis and intrusion detection (IDS/IPS) Incident response, including triage, incident analysis/forensics and remediation.
Supports the Bank’s operational information security responsibilities, including the development and maintenance of standards, procedures, and guidelines necessary to satisfy the Information Security department’s network operations.
Proactively monitors and investigates network security alerts from managed security service providers and in-house security tools.

Work in a customer service setting. Effectively communicates with end users and upper management of all levels.
Travel 0-10%.

Industry Standard Certifications, such as: CompTIA A+; CompTIA Networks +; CompTIA Security +; ISC2 CISSP, CCNA, CEH are preferred.

Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

This job is responsible for providing oversight of financial crimes investigation activities, including the performance of end-to-end investigations/ investigations support functions of external activities across one or more lines of business. Key responsibilities include overseeing investigative efforts related to fraud, money laundering, or terrorist financing, ensuring timely and accurate reporting of suspicious activity, and managing interactions with Law Enforcement as required. Job expectations include ensuring significant issues and financial crimes trends are effectively reported.

Responsibilities:

Oversees investigative efforts, reviewing and approving cases and ensuring the delivery of timely and accurate regulatory reporting
Provides oversight of a team of Investigators or activities performing end-to-end investigations of financial crimes activities
Ensures that the completion of Suspicious Activity Reports is conducted in a timely and accurate manner for submission to regulators and/or law enforcement, while providing review and oversight
Reviews facts of the investigation, and escalates risk to senior stakeholders and partners with Front Line Units to resolve
Leads quality control functions, training, communications, guidance, monitoring scenario development/enhancement input and testing, or law enforcement liaison responsibilities in an investigative support role
Evaluates internal controls to ensure they are working effectively by identifying weaknesses or gaps

Managerial Responsibilities:

This position may also have responsibilities for managing associates. At Bank of America, all managers at this level demonstrate the following responsibilities, in addition to those specific to the role, listed above.

Opportunity & Inclusion Champion: Models an inclusive environment for employees and clients, aligned to company Great Place to Work goals.
Manager of Process & Data: Demonstrates deep process knowledge, operational excellence and innovation through a focus on simplicity, data based decision making and continuous improvement.
Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Communicates enterprise decisions, purpose, and results, and connects to team strategy, priorities and contributions.
Risk Manager: Ensures proper risk discipline, controls and culture are in place to identify, escalate and debate issues.
People Manager & Coach: Provides inspection, coaching and feedback to motivate, differentiate and improve performance.
Financial Steward: Actively manages expenses and budgets in alignment with objectives, making sound financial decisions.
Enterprise Talent Leader: Assesses talent and builds bench strength for roles across the organization.
Driver of Business Outcomes: Delivers results by effectively prioritizing, inspecting and appropriately delegating team work.

Minimum of five years of relevant experience

Bachelor's Degree in related field
Experience in financial services and/or a related government entity
Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)

new_jobs.title: Senior Environmental Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Overview

At UES, we’re a team of more than 4,000 engineers, scientists, geologists, inspectors, technicians, and drillers united by a shared purpose—to make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. As a national leader in geotechnical engineering, environmental consulting, and materials testing and inspection, we collaborate on transformative projects across transportation, energy, water, healthcare, and more. Learn more about the benefits of joining Team UES and our core values at careers.teamues.com.

Position Overview

The Senior Geologist serves as a technical expert and project lead on complex environmental and geological assignments. This role oversees field teams, reviews technical deliverables, and ensures the highest standards of quality, safety, and compliance. The Senior Geologist also mentors junior geologists and provides strategic input into proposal development and project planning.

The Senior Environmental Project Manager will be responsible for overall project management of Phase I/II Environmental Site Assessments, which may include various types of properties such as undeveloped land, agricultural, residential, multi-family, retail, and commercial/industrial. Responsible for completion and overall success of the project, including resource allocation, project scheduling, budgeting, and forecasting. Lead project meetings, generate reports, and update both the project team and client on progress. Set priorities, assign tasks, and coordinate staff to achieve project goals and milestones. May also serve as the primary client contact, ensuring deliverables meet expectations.

Responsibilities

Lead and oversee complex site investigations, remediation efforts, and regulatory compliance activities.
Perform and review detailed data interpretation, modeling, and advanced geologic or hydrogeologic analysis.
Prepare, review, and sign off on technical reports, including regulatory submittals and risk assessments.
Mentor and train junior geologists in field techniques, reporting, and regulatory understanding.
Manage client relationships and act as a technical point of contact on projects.
Develop scopes of work, schedules, and budgets for proposals and ongoing projects.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and regulatory agencies to ensure project success.
Evaluate and implement process improvements to enhance safety, efficiency, and technical quality.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Hydrogeology, or Environmental Science; Master’s degree preferred.
8+ years of progressive experience in environmental site investigation, remediation, or regulatory compliance
FG certification required; Professional Geologist (PG) license strongly preferred or required based on state
OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER certification and current refresher
valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
Expertise in environmental regulations, risk-based remediation strategies, and project lifecycle management.
Advanced proficiency in field instrumentation, data interpretation, geologic modeling, and QA/QC processes
Proven experience leading technical teams, mentoring junior staff, and managing client relationships
Strong track record of writing, reviewing, and signing off on regulatory submittals, proposals, and reports.
Strategic thinking, project scoping, and budgeting experience preferred.

Travel Requirements

This position requires moderate travel, approximately up to 20% to 40% of the time, in support of business

objectives and client engagements. Travel may be both scheduled and on short notice, depending on

project needs. Destinations typically include job sites, field locations, or regional offices, where work may

be conducted in outdoor or operational environments. Adherence to all company safety protocols and

use of PPE is required during travel and on-site work.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

This position primarily works in an outdoor work environment, regularly exposed to varying field conditions, including:
Sites that may not be accessible by vehicle, requiring travel on foot through wetlands, swamps, grasslands, fields, and other uneven or rugged terrain with natural and man-made obstacles such as sand, brush, and debris.
Moderate to loud noise levels, common in active construction and industrial environments.
Exposure to environmental elements including dirt, dust, sun, heat, humidity, and adverse weather conditions.

The physical requirements for this position may include and are not limited to:
Ability to lift and/or carry 35 to 75 lbs. up to 75 feet, involving regular repetitive motion.
Ability to stand, walk, drive, and operate equipment for extended periods.
Frequent use of hands and arms for typing, handling tools, and operating equipment.
Ability to bend, twist, reach, stoop, pull, kneel, climb, balance, lift, carry, and push as required for fieldwork and inspections.
Ability to speak and hear effectively to communicate in noisy environments and with project teams.
Ability to use your senses to see (including close, distant, and peripheral vison, depth vision, and ability to focus) smell, hear, touch (use hands to reach climb or balance, crouch, stoop, crawl, kneel and sit)

new_jobs.title: Risk and Research Analyst, Keurig Trading
new_jobs.description:
Job Overview:

Risk & Research Analyst, Risk Management, Keurig Trading

Join Keurig Trading’s Risk Management team in a data and information centric role supporting commodity risk decisions through rigorous analysis, reporting, modeling, and market research. The Risk & Research Analyst transforms internal business data and external market intelligence into reliable insights, forecasts, and decision-support materials. Working closely with Risk Management, Sourcing, Procurement, Supply Chain Finance, Treasury, and other business partners, this role strengthens the quality, consistency, and transparency of risk information.

This position will be based in Lausanne, Switzerland, and will report to the Senior Director, Commodity Risk Management at Keurig Trading.

What you will do:

Market data, research and modeling
Analyze commodity market fundamentals, price drivers, supply-demand dynamics, and macroeconomic trends to identify emerging risks, scenarios, and business implications.
Develop, maintain, and enhance commodity supply-demand, pricing, cost, exposure, and forecasting models using internal business data and external market intelligence.
Collect, validate, structure, and synthesize information from industry research, market data providers, brokers, counterparties, and public sources.
Apply quantitative, statistical, and scenario-based analysis to improve market views, forecasts, risk assessments, and hedging decision support.
Risk analytics, reporting and decision support
Produce accurate and timely daily, weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting on commodity exposures, coverage levels, market movements, pricing risk, and hedge performance.
Build and maintain analytical dashboards, management reports, data visualizations, and presentation materials that clearly communicate key trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Perform variance, sensitivity, trend, and scenario analysis to explain changes in exposure, market value, forecast cost, and risk position.
Translate complex datasets and market information into concise insights, business implications, and actionable recommendations for stakeholders and senior leadership.
Support recurring planning, forecasting, and performance-review processes by providing consistent analytical inputs and well-documented assumptions.
Maintain reliable data models, source files, reporting logic, and documentation to support consistent and reproducible analysis across Risk Management activities.
Validate and reconcile market data, transactions, positions, valuations, forecasts, and counterparty information, investigating and resolving data discrepancies in a timely manner.
Partner with Controlling, Treasury, Procurement, Accounting, and Technology teams to strengthen the integrity of market pricing, risk reporting, management information, and hedge-accounting inputs.
Contribute to the development and optimization of risk management systems, analytical tools, reporting solutions, and automated workflows.
Identify opportunities to improve data accessibility, reporting efficiency, model accuracy, transparency, controls, and user experience.
Develop and maintain clear process documentation, model assumptions, data definitions, controls, and audit evidence.
Support the enhancement of commodity risk methodologies, analytical frameworks, key performance indicators, and governance standards.
Participate in cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives requiring commodity market, risk, financial, or data analysis.

Additional responsibilities:

Prepare high-quality analyses, presentations, and briefing materials for meetings with Finance, Procurement, Commercial, Supply Chain, and senior leadership stakeholders.
Monitor open coffee purchase commitments and unpriced exposures, assist in execution of approved coffee price fixations under direction.
Support internal and external audits by maintaining appropriate documentation, data lineage, evidence, and process controls.
