JOB OVERVIEW:

The Procurement Enablement & Operations Analyst leads two areas 1) source-to-pay process: Procurement Enablement (the policies, systems, data, KPIs and training that let the business buy correctly) and 2) Operational Procurement (the day-to-day execution of vendor onboarding, purchase requisition (PR) to purchase order (PO) conversion, outline agreements and compliance reporting).
This role has strong business and system acumen. The analyst understands how procurement decisions affect cost, cash, supply continuity and financial controls, and how those processes are built in SAP S/4HANA and Ariba. The role sets up the procurement KPI framework (retro spend, vendor onboarding etc), measures and enforces compliance, and drives corrective actions with Buyers, requisitioners, suppliers, AP, Finance, IT and Operations. It is the go-to resource for procurement process and system

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Essential Job Functions

Procurement Enablement

Translate procurement policy and approval rules (delegation of authority, contract requirements) into clear processes, system workflows and release strategies in SAP/Ariba)
Design and maintain buying channels (catalogs, SAP contracts, scheduling agreements, spot buys) so requisitioners are guided to the right supplier, price and approval path
Write and maintain procurement procedures, work instructions, desk guides and training; onboard and train requisitioners, buyers and approvers on policy and system use
Act as procurement key user for SAP and Ariba: resolves/ addresses issues, define business requirements, test changes (UAT) and support releases and go-lives with IT
Identify and deliver simplification and automation opportunities (touchless POs, approval routing, catalogs, workflow, self-service reporting) with IT, AP and Finance
Define rules to tackle tail spend and reduce supplier onboarding.
Set up the procurement KPI framework: define metrics, calculation rules, data sources, targets, owners and reporting cadence. Lead root-cause analysis on KPI misses
Enforce procurement policy by monitoring exceptions, escalating repeat non-compliance and working with managers to close gaps

Operational Procurement

Own the vendor onboarding workflow in SAP/Ariba (SLP), from request and due diligence to approval and activation, with complete tax, and certification documents
Set and enforce supplier master data standards (purchasing org, payment terms, Incoterms, partner functions); lead vendor master clean-up, blocking and de-duplication with AP and Finance
Manage the PR-to-PO pipeline: monitor open requisitions, convert PRs to POs, and reduce cycle time and manual touches
Maintain source lists, purchasing info records and pricing conditions so requisitions route to the right Buyer, approver and agreement.
Create, maintain and monitor outline agreements (value and quantity contracts, scheduling agreements); track consumption, expirations and price changes and alert Buyers ahead of renewals
Maintain supplier records, contracts, and vendor information
Coordinate vendor communications and follow-up actions

Compliance, Controls & Audit

Procurement compliance reporting: approval-policy adherence, contract coverage, vendor master changes and segregation-of-duties conflicts
Support internal and external audits and reporting requirements.

Business & System Acumen

Understand how procurement links to planning/MRP, receiving, Inventory, AP, Finance, and how a change in one area affects the others
Use knowledge of SAP data structures, standard reports and transactions to diagnose issues, reconcile data and propose fixes
Weigh cost, risk, cashflow, control and user-experience trade-offs when recommending process or system changes; build business cases where needed
Champion disciplined procurement execution and governance across plants, projects and business functions

Minimum Job Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Information Systems or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
5+ years of experience in procurement operations, purchasing, sourcing or source-to-pay, preferably in manufacturing, CPG, food/agriculture or operations
3+ years of hands-on SAP purchasing experience, including PRs, POs, outline agreements, info records, source lists and vendor master data
Proven experience setting up and reporting procurement KPIs, and driving corrective actions to closure
Demonstrated ownership of vendor onboarding, procurement policy compliance or procurement enablement (training, process design, system rollout)

Preferred Skills And Experiences

Strong business and system acumen across the end-to-end procure-to-pay process
Advanced Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups, data modeling) and strong analytical, root-cause and problem-solving skills
Able to enforce policy and hold stakeholders accountable while keeping strong working relationships
High data accuracy, attention to detail and understanding of internal controls
Able to train stakeholders at all levels
Able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Supervisory Responsibilities

N/A

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Sitting for prolonged periods.
Walking through warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and multiple buildings.
Occasional bending and lifting.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Office environment with a hybrid model of three days in the office, based on business needs. Time spent in distribution, warehouse, and production areas. Exposure to dust, moisture, noise, and hot or cold temperatures. Frequent interaction with suppliers, carriers, 3PL providers, and cross-functional business partners.

What Makes Us, Us 

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT FOR US

SimCorp is currently seeking a qualified professional to join our Market Data Services team as a full-time employee, based in our Manila office. In this role, the Analyst will produce high quality value-added content, by working closely with the Development, Research, Product and Client Support business units.

The output of the Analyst’s work will consist of producing a suite of daily-updated multi-factor risk models and multi-asset class data analytics.

The selected candidate will provide continuous operational support for leading products serving global sell-side, buy-side, hedge fund, and asset owner clients. The candidate will use quantitative and qualitative skills to manage the ongoing maintenance of financial market data products, which include operational processes, data analysis, and quality assurance.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Perform Quality Assurance tasks and data analysis to ensure validity of content produced and delivered to SimCorp’s clients
Monitor financial markets and ensure the correct processing of corporate events, such as IPOs, M&As, stock splits, rights issues, and dividend distributions
Work closely with other team members based in the London, Warsaw, Hong Kong, Buenos Aires, Mexico City, and San Francisco offices of SimCorp

Seek out ways to streamline workflows when suitable
Collaborate and communicate across all teams involved with data production process

new_jobs.description:
Senior Strategic Data Analyst, Growth & Placement

Austin, TX (Onsite 4 days per week)

Note: This is a full-time role. We do not offer C2C or C2H employment and are not able to sponsor visas for this position.

About Acrisure

Acrisure is a global fintech leader empowering millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human expertise together, we connect clients with customized solutions across insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services, and more. In the last twelve years, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to almost $5 billion and employs over 19,000 colleagues in more than 20 countries.

The Role

Acrisure's Growth & Placement Analytics team supporting the executive leadership of our North America Insurance business operates at the intersection of data and business strategy, translating complex data assets into decisions that drive revenue and operational performance. As a Senior Strategic Data Analyst on the Growth & Placement pod, you will operate as a trusted senior individual contributor owning strategically ambiguous, high-stakes analytical questions facing NAI leadership and driving them from initial framing through executive-ready recommendation.

This is not a role where the questions are handed to you. You will independently identify what the business needs to understand, structure the analytical approach, and shape the agenda in partnership with senior executives. Your findings will directly inform decisions with enterprise-wide impact, and the analytical products you build will be used across NAI leadership, operating teams, and downstream analytical functions.

Beyond delivery, you will set the standard for analytical rigor within the team. This is a thought-leadership role: you establish the patterns others follow — how we frame ambiguous problems, how we communicate data limitations, how we integrate AI tooling into production analytical workflows without compromising trust. You are expected to raise the ceiling of what the team can do.

Acrisure is investing significantly in its data infrastructure, most visibly through the adoption of Palantir Foundry as our enterprise analytics and application platform. You will have the autonomy and expectation to shape how those investments translate into analytical value for the business, and to architect the data assets required to answer questions that don't yet have precedent.

How You'll Drive Impact:

Own the analytical framing of the most strategically important and ambiguous questions facing NAI leadership — deciding what merits investigation, defining the approach, and driving the work from problem definition through executive-ready recommendation with minimal oversight.
Design and deliver enterprise-scale analytical products end-to-end — from metric definition and data modeling through self-service delivery — that serve multiple audiences across NAI leadership, operating teams, and downstream analytical functions.
Independently engage senior executive stakeholders to shape the analytical agenda rather than react to it, and to translate ambiguous business questions into structured, defensible answers.
Lead multi-quarter analytical initiatives that require sustained investigation, integration of insights across functions, and pattern recognition across large, multi-source datasets.
Set the standard for analytical rigor across the team, establishing patterns for how we frame problems, communicate data limitations, and build analytical trust with executive audiences.
Write and optimize expert-level SQL against Palantir Foundry; architect the data models and pipelines required to support new categories of analysis; extend dbt models and Palantir Ontology objects where the analysis demands it.
Architect and productionize AI-augmented analytical workflows such as Generative AI classification pipelines and integrated analysis that scale analytical capacity while preserving rigorous verification standards. You define what "trustworthy" looks like when AI is in the workflow.
Champion intellectual honesty about what the data does and doesn't support — setting the tone for the team on when to say "we don't know yet" and how to make that observation actionable rather than paralyzing.

You May Be a Fit If You Have:

5–8 years of professional experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a strategy-adjacent analytics role, with a clear trajectory of increasing scope and autonomy over that time.
Expert command of SQL: you write complex analytical queries fluently across window functions, CTEs, and multi-table joins; you optimize your own queries; and you can architect data logic that others build on.
A demonstrable track record of owning end-to-end analytical products that serve broad stakeholder populations — from metric definition and data modeling through self-service delivery, not just contributing to work owned by others.
Deep experience with a modern cloud data warehouse and hands-on data modeling experience with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework.
Proven ability to independently frame ambiguous business problems, structure the analytical approach, and drive multi-quarter initiatives with minimal oversight.
Executive-grade communication — you can walk into a C-suite conversation, set the terms of the discussion, and defend your analytical position in real time. Written and verbal fluency at that altitude are both expected.
The intellectual honesty and confidence to say 'the data doesn't fully answer this question, and here's why' — and to make that observation productive rather than deflating.
Experience integrating AI or ML into analytical workflows at production quality — for example, Gen AI classification pipelines, prompt-engineered analytical automation, or Claude/LLM-integrated analytical products.
Experience with a BI or visualization tool (Tableau, Power BI) and a track record of delivering to multiple audiences from a single data foundation.
A genuine interest in developing deep expertise in Palantir Foundry and the intellectual openness to become one of the team's Foundry authorities.
A skeptic's relationship with AI tools — you use them, you benefit from them, but you validate their outputs rigorously before letting them inform business decisions or ship to production.
A bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical field, or equivalent professional experience. Advanced degrees in analytics, data science, or a related field are welcomed but not required.

Nice to Have:

Direct hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry, including Ontology modeling or Workshop application development.
Python proficiency, particularly for analytical automation, data transformation, or ML/AI pipeline development.
Experience in insurance, financial services, or other complex B2B commercial environments.
Prior experience directly presenting findings to C-suite audiences and defending analytical recommendations in executive forums.
Experience establishing analytical standards, playbooks, or reusable patterns adopted by a broader analytics team.
Exposure to agile development practices, Git-based workflows, and project tracking tools like Jira.

Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership.

Benefits and Perks:

Competitive compensation
Generous vacation policy, paid holidays, and paid sick time
Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, and Vision Insurance (employee-paid)
Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
Company-paid Group Life insurance
Company-paid Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Calm App subscription
Employee-paid Pet Insurance and optional supplemental insurance coverage
Vested 401(k) with company match and financial wellness programs
Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA) and commuter benefits options
Paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, and fertility benefits
Career growth and learning opportunities
…and so much more!

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst - Strategy & Commercial
new_jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new
. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Back Market runs on data. Every insight we surface, every model we build, every anomaly we catch is a step toward making refurbished tech the world's obvious choice — not the alternative.

Our Data, Analytics & Insights team is expanding, and we're opening three analytical ownership roles at once: Strategy & Commercial, Customer Care, and Shipping & Logistics.

One application. One process. We'll find the best fit together.

Wherever you land, you'll own a domain end-to-end — from the data model to the boardroom decision. These aren't reporting roles. They're roles where your analytical judgment drives real business direction.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT) 🥇

Depending on which domain becomes your home, here's what you'll own:

Strategy & Commercial Analytics

Monitor and diagnose commercial performance for Central Europe — weekly, proactively, with course-correction plans ready before anyone asks
Contribute to 12M+ sales forecasting and P&L budgeting, translating initiative impacts into tactical recommendations when the trajectory drifts
Build data models and tooling that surface actionable pricing signals to the commercial and revenue teams
Enable self-service access to pricing and supply health data across the organisation

Across All Domains, You'll

Own your analytical domain end-to-end — from data model to decision, you're the go-to person
Partner directly with senior leadership — not just delivering analyses, but shaping the questions we ask
At Staff level: mentor junior analysts and raise the bar for how the team approaches problems

🛠️ Tech Stack

What The Team Works With Day-to-day

Data Warehouse: Google BigQuery
Transformation: dbt
Visualisation & BI: Omni, Amplitude
Languages: SQL (essential), Python (very useful)
Care tooling: Zendesk, Intercom
Experimentation: A/B testing and incrementality frameworks

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF ⭐

You Have

Strong SQL proficiency and comfort working with large, complex datasets — you can build the query and explain what the result means for the business in the same breath
A track record of owning analytical problem spaces end-to-end — outcomes that shaped business direction, not just answered one-off questions
A rigorous analytical mindset: you understand causal vs. correlational reasoning, know the limits of your data, and can design a measurement framework from scratch
Excellent communication and storytelling skills — you distil complex, multi-variable analyses into crisp narratives that move senior stakeholders to act
Experience in business analytics, commercial strategy, or a customer-facing operations domain (marketplace, e-commerce, logistics, or similar)
5+ years of experience in data analytics, or equivalent hands-on analytical ownership

Nice To Have

Python proficiency for statistical work, modelling, or analytical automation
Domain familiarity: pricing/revenue management for Commercial; care platform experience (Zendesk, Intercom) for Care; logistics or carrier analytics for Shipping
Experience designing experiments in an operational context (A/B tests, holdouts, or incrementality measurement)

Even if you don't tick every box, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse analytical backgrounds and unconventional paths to expertise.

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

Benefits

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.
Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.
Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

We are looking for Associate Data Analyst who has a passion for analytical problem solving to be part of our growing team. This individual will solve a wide range of problems related to content analytics, interaction and events analytics, demand sensing, staffing models, cost reporting, automation, expert performance analytics, standard reporting, and ad-hoc analytics. new_jobs.title: Marketing Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
N-iX is a software engineering company with around 2,400 engineers. We were founded in Lviv in 2002, we are headquartered in Malta, and we work with clients across the US, the UK, and the DACH region. We help enterprise technology leaders build and modernize software, data, cloud, and embedded systems, and we position ourselves as a Pragmatic AI Software Engineering partner.
Our go-to-market is inbound-led. Most of our new business starts on our website, and our business development team is small. That means marketing data is not a reporting exercise for us. It is how the company decides where to invest.

Why this role exists

We need one person who owns the numbers behind marketing and turns them into decisions. You will connect website behavior, channel performance, and pipeline outcomes into a single view, explain what is driving change, and recommend what we should do next.
You will work directly with the CMO and present to the N-iX leadership team. The work you produce will shape budget allocation, channel strategy, and the annual marketing plan. You will partner with paid search, organic search and content, ABM and events, and brand and PR leads in the marketing team to set targets and measure results. You will also collaborate with Sales, Business Development, Finance, and Delivery to align on pipeline definitions and shared metrics

What you will do:

Pipeline and performance analytics

Own marketing pipeline reporting from first visit to qualified opportunity and closed revenue.
Analyze performance by channel, campaign, content asset, region, and persona, and identify which activities produce qualified pipeline from our ICP (CTO, CIO, and VP Engineering buyers at companies with 500+ employees).
Separate pipeline volume from pipeline quality, and track conversion and velocity at each funnel stage.
Build and maintain the weekly qualified pipeline view used in leadership meetings, with written commentary that explains the movement, not only the figures.
Run quarterly reviews of channel mix and spend efficiency, and propose where to shift budget.

Web and digital analytics

Treat the website as our primary revenue channel. Measure and improve how visitors move from landing page to conversion.
Act as the team's GA4 expert, and keep website tracking accurate as the site and campaigns change.
Track paid search, organic search, ABM, events, and social performance in a consistent framework so the team can compare channels fairly.
Design and analyze experiments on pages, forms, and campaigns, and report results with clear confidence levels.

Modeling and forecasting

Use statistical methods such as segmentation, regression, and predictive modeling to find patterns in large marketing and sales datasets.
Build pipeline and lead volume forecasts using coverage ratios and cohort-based methods to support quarterly planning.
Develop and maintain an attribution approach that fits a long, multi-touch B2B buying cycle. Explain the trade-offs between models, such as first-touch and last-touch, so stakeholders understand what the numbers can and cannot tell them.

KPI governance and data quality

Own the reporting data model that joins CRM, web analytics, and ad platform data in our warehouse.
Build data quality checks and reconciliation steps that catch anomalies before they reach a dashboard.
When data is wrong, find the cause at the source and fix it with the system owner, rather than patching the report.
Work with data engineering, sales operations, and IT to keep tracking, CRM data, and reporting accurate and current.

Storytelling and leadership reporting

Explain why performance changed, in plain language, for executives, marketers, and sales leaders.
Build dashboards and visuals that make trends easy to read at a glance.
Frame every insight against company goals: what it means, what the risk or opportunity is, and what you recommend.

Automation, AI, and self-service

Use AI tools such as Claude as a default part of how you query, model, analyze, and document, not as an occasional experiment.
Automate recurring reports so your time goes to analysis, not assembly.
Build self-service reporting so the marketing team can answer routine performance questions without a custom request.

What you bring

Required:

5+ years in professional analytics, including 3+ years in marketing or revenue operations at a B2B SaaS, technology services, or IT consulting company.
English level - Upper Intermediate or higher
Proven track record of presenting insights through storytelling to senior leaders and driving decision-making changes.
Strong SQL and working proficiency in Python or R, with applied statistics experience such as predictive modeling or causal inference.
Advanced GA4 experience, plus hands-on experience with a CRM (Salesforce preferred) and paid media platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads).
Working knowledge of the CRM object model (leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, campaigns) and how funnel metrics map onto it.
Fluency in B2B funnel metrics such as MQL to Target Opportunity conversion, pipeline velocity, and ACV, and an understanding of why each one matters.
Experience building dashboards in a BI tool (Power BI, Looker, Looker Studio, or similar).
Daily use of AI tools in analytical work, with sound judgment about when to trust and when to check the output.
Experience with B2B funnels with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders on the buying side.
A degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research, or Data Science.

Nice to have:

Experience with incrementality testing in B2B, such as holdout or lift tests on paid search and LinkedIn, and an understanding of where methods like media mix modeling do and do not apply at lower data volumes.
Experience building dimensional data models (star or snowflake schemas) in a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery or Snowflake.
Python for automation and data quality scripts.
Experience with intent data, sales engagement, or conversation intelligence platforms.
Familiarity with SEO tools (Ahrefs, Google Ads, Google Search Console) and behavior analytics (Microsoft Clarity or similar)
Familiarity with marketing automation platforms and how data gets distorted at the point of capture
